sections.title: The throne of the Lord.

verses.text: In the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, on the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw the vision of God.
King Jehoiakim was in the eighth year, in the fifth month, on the fifth day of the month.
The word of the Lord came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the Lord was upon me there.

And I looked, and behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness was about it, and out of the midst thereof as the color of amber, out of the midst of the fire.
And out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance; they had the likeness of a man.
And every one had four faces, and every one of them had four wings.
And their feet were straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf's foot; and they sparkled like the color of burnished brass.
And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings thus.
Their wings were joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.

As for the likeness of their faces, they four had the face of a man, and the face of a lion on the right side; and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four also had the face of an eagle.
ክንፋቸውም በላይ ተዘርግቶ ነበር፤ የእያንዳንዱም ሁለት ሁለት ክንፋቸው የተያያዙ ነበሩ፤ ሁለት ሁለቱም ገላቸውን ይከድኑ ነበር።
እያንዳንዱም ወደ ፊት ቀጥ ብሎ ይሄድ ነበር፤ መንፈስም ወደሚሄድበት ሁሉ ይሄዱ ነበር፤ ሲሄዱም ወዲያና ወዲህ አይሉም ነበር።
በእንስሶቹም መካከል እንደሚነድድ የእሳት ፍም ያለ አምሳያ ነበረ፤ በእንስሶቹ መካከል ወዲህና ወዲያ የሚሄድ እንደ ፋና ያለ አምሳያ ነበረ፤ ለእሳቱም ፀዳል ነበረው፤ ከእሳቱም መብረቅ ይወጣ ነበር።
እንስሶቹም እንደ መብረቅ አምሳያ ይሮጡና ይመለሱ ነበር።
ስመለከትም፥ እነሆ በአራቱ እንስሶች አጠገብ በምድር ላይ አንድ መንኰራኵር አየሁ።
የመንኰራኵሩም መልክ እንደ ቢረሌ ነበረ፤ አራቱም አንድ አምሳያ ነበሩ፤ ሥራቸውም በመንኰራኵር ውስጥ እንዳለ መንኰራኵር ነበረ።
በእየአራቱም ጐድናቸው ይሄዱ ነበር፤ ሲሄዱም ጀርባቸውን አይመልሱም ነበር። ከፍ ከፍ ያሉም ነበሩ።
በአራቱ ዙሪያ ሁሉ ዐይኖችን የተመላ ጀርባቸውን አየሁ፤
በሄዱም ጊዜ ሠረገላዎች ከእነርሱ ጋር ይሄዳሉ። እንስሶቹም ከምድር ሲነሡ መንኰራኵሮቹም ከእነርሱ ጋር ይነሣሉ።
ደመና ባለበት በዚያ መንፈስ አለ፤ እንስሶቹ ይሄዳሉ፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር መንኰራኵሮቹ ይነሣሉ፤ የሕይወት መንፈስ በመንኰራኵሮች አለና።
በሄዱም ጊዜ ይሄዳሉ፤ በቆሙም ጊዜ ይቆማሉ፤ በእነዚያ መንኰራኵሮች ውስጥ የሕይወት መንፈስ አለና ከምድር በተነሡ ጊዜ መንኰራኵሮቹ ከእነርሱ ጋር ይነሣሉ።
በእነዚያ እንስሶች ራስ ላይ ያለው መልክ ከላይ በክንፎቻቸው ላይ የተዘረጋ የበረድ መልክ እንዳለበት ጠፈር ነው፤
ከጠፈሩም በታች ክንፎቻቸው እርስ በርሳቸው ተቃንተው ነበር፤ ለእያንዳንዱም ገላውን የሚከድኑ ሁለት ሁለት ክንፎች ነበሩት።
ሲሄዱም የክንፎቻቸው ድምፅ እንደ ብዙ ውኃ ድምፅ፥ ሁሉን እንደሚችል የአምላክም ድምፅ፥ እንደ ታላቅ ሠራዊትም ድምፅ ሆኖ ሰማሁ፤ ሲቆሙም ክንፎቻቸውን ይሰበስቡ ነበር።
በራሳቸውም ላይ ካለው ጠፈር በላይ ድምፅ ተሰማ፤ ሲቆሙም ክንፎቻቸውን ይሰበስቡ ነበር።
በራሳቸውም በላይ ከአለው ጠፈር በላይ የሰንፔር ድንጋይ የሚመስል የዙፋን አምሳያ ነበረ፤ በዙፋኑም አምሳያ ላይ እንደ ሰው መልክ አምሳያ ነበረ።
ከወገቡም አምሳያ ወደ ላይ የሚብለጨለጭ የወርቅ አምሳያ አየሁ፤ ከወገቡም አምሳያ ወደ ታች እንደ እሳት አምሳያ አየሁ፤ በዙሪያውም ፀዳል ነበረ።
በዝናብ ቀን በደመና ውስጥ እንደ አለ ቀስተ ደመና አምሳያ፥ እንዲሁ በዙሪያው ያለ ፀዳል አምሳያ ነበረ። የእግዚአብሔር ክብር ምሳሌ መልክ ይህ ነበረ። በአየሁም ጊዜ በግንባሬ ተደፋሁ። የሚናገርንም ድምፅ ሰማሁ።

sections.title: The Lord called Ezekiel to the prophetic ministry.

verses.text: And He said unto me, “O son of man! Stand upon thy feet; and I will speak unto thee.”
And when He spake unto me, the Spirit came upon me, and raised me up, and I stood upon my feet; and I heard Him that spake unto me.

And He said unto me, “O son of man! I send thee unto the children of Israel, to a rebellious nation that hath rebelled against Me; they and their fathers have transgressed against Me even unto this very day.
They are children with hard faces and stubborn hearts. I send thee unto them; and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God.
“And they are a rebellious house; if they hear or if they forbear, they shall know that a prophet hath been among them.”
O son of man! Though thorns and briars be with thee, and thou dost dwell among scorpions, be not afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks; for they are a rebellious house.
Since they are a rebellious house, if they hear or if they be afraid, thou shalt speak My words unto them.
“O son of man! Hear what I say unto thee; be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house; open thy mouth, and eat that I give thee.”
And when I looked, behold, a hand was sent unto me; and, lo, a roll of a book was therein.
And He spread it before me; and it was written within and without; and there was written therein lamentations, and mourning, and woe.
And He said, “O son of man! Eat what thou hast received; read this book; go and speak unto the children of Israel.”
I also opened my mouth, and He caused me to eat the book.
And He said, “O son of man! Let thy mouth eat; and fill thy belly with this book.” And I did eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.
Then He said unto me, “O son of man! Arise, go unto the house of Israel, and speak unto them My words.”
But go not unto the house of Israel to speak unto them a strange language, nor to a people of a strange speech; for I have not sent thee unto them.
If I were to send thee unto them, they would not hearken unto thee; for the house of Israel is a rebellious house, and their language is strange.
But behold, I have made thy face strong against their faces, and thy forehead strong against their foreheads.
As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead; fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, for they are a rebellious house.”
Moreover, He said, “O son of man! All My words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thine heart, and hear with thine ears.”
"Arise and go unto your children whom you have taught; and if they hear or are afraid, say unto them, 'Thus says the Lord God: I have spoken.'"
"And the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me a great voice, saying, 'Blessed be the glory of the Lord from His place.'"
"And when those creatures moved, I heard the sound of their wings, and the sound of a great voice."
"And the Spirit lifted me up and brought me; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of the Lord was strong upon me."
"And I went to Tel Abib, by the river of Chebar, and I sat where they sat; and I remained there astonished among them seven days."

sections.title: The Lord appointed Ezekiel as a watchman, even as He commanded him.

verses.text: ከሰባቱም ቀን በኋላ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፦
“የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! ለእስራኤል ቤት ጕበኛ አድርጌሃለሁ፤ ስለዚህ የአፌን ቃል ስማ፤ በቃሌም ገሥጻቸው።
እኔ ኀጢአተኛውን፥ “በእርግጥ ትሞታለህ ባልሁት ጊዜ አንተም ባትነግረው፥ ነፍሱም እንድትድን ከክፉ መንገዱ ይመለስ ዘንድ ለኀጢአተኛው ባትነግረው፥ ያ ኀጢአተኛ በኀጢአቱ ይሞታል፤ ደሙን ግን ከእጅህ እፈልጋለሁ።
ነገር ግን አንተ ኀጢአተኛውን ብትገሥጸው እርሱም ከኀጢአቱና ከክፉ መንገዱ ባይመለስ፥ በኀጢአቱ ይሞታል፤ አንተ ግን ነፍስህን ታድናለህ።
ደግሞ ጻድቁ ከጽድቁ ተመልሶ ኀጢአት በሠራ ጊዜ እኔ በፊቱ ዕንቅፋት ባደርግ፥ እርሱ ይሞታል፤ አንተም አልነገርኸውምና በኀጢአቱ ይሞታል፤ ያደረጋትም የጽድቅ ነገር አትታሰብለትም፤ ደሙን ግን ከእጅህ እፈልጋለሁ።
ነገር ግን ኀጢአት እንዳይሠራ ጻድቁን ብትገሥጸው፥ እርሱም ኀጢአት ባይሠራ፥ ጻድቅ ነውና በሕይወት ይኖራል፤ አንተም ነፍስህን አድነሃል።”
በዚያም የእግዚአብሔር እጅ በእኔ ላይ ነበረች፤ እርሱም፥ “ተነሥተህ ወደ ሜዳ ሂድ፤ በዚያም እነግርሃለሁ” አለኝ።
እኔም ተነሥቼ ወደ ሜዳው ሄድሁ፤ እነሆም በኮቦር ወንዝ እንዳየሁት ክብር ያለ የእግዚአብሔር ክብር በዚያ ቆሞ ነበር፤ በግምባሬም ተደፋሁ።
መንፈስም ወደ እኔ መጣ፤ በእግሬም አቆመኝ፤ ተናገረኝም እንዲህም አለኝ፥ “ሂድ ገብተህ ቤትህን ዝጋ።
አንተም፥ የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! እነሆ ገመድ ያደርጉብሃል፤ ያስሩህማል፤ አንተም ከመካከላቸው አትወጣም፤
And I shall entreat you with your speech; and you shall indeed be as a fool; for they are a house of the dead, and let not a man be among them who is deceived.

Yet when I speak to you, I shall open your mouth; for they are a house of the dead, and you: thus saith the Lord God, “Let him that hath ears hear; and let him that is unwilling be unwilling.” You shall say unto them.

sections.title: Ezekiel, as a watchman for Jerusalem, shall guard against its foes as a sentinel.

verses.text: "O son of man! Take the cup and drink it before you; and the image of the city of Jerusalem, let it be a sign unto you;
And within it, let there be a work of the wall; and in the army, let there be a banner; and around it, let there be a host; and send forth the host that is gathered unto its place.

Even the iron rod, take it among you and the city; make a gate of iron; and direct your face toward her; she shall be honored; and you shall honor her. This shall be a sign for the children of Israel.
"And you shall lie on your left side; and while you lie, bear the iniquity of the house of Israel; and you shall carry their iniquities.
And I have given you the years of their iniquity for a number of days, three hundred and ninety days; and you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
And when you have completed these, you shall lie on your right side; and you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Judah for forty days; I have appointed you one day for each year.
And toward Jerusalem, your face shall be set; and your arm shall be bared; and in her, you shall prophesy.
Behold, I have made a cord for you; as long as you do not fulfill the time of your appointed season, do not turn from side to side.

"And you shall take wheat and barley, beans and lentils, millet and spelt, and put them into one vessel, and make bread of them; and you shall eat it as the number of days that you lie on your side, three hundred and ninety days, you shall eat it.
And the food that you eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day; from time to time, you shall eat it."
And thou shalt drink water in measure, one hand from six hands; at all times thou shalt drink it.
Thou shalt eat the locusts of the grasshopper; and thou shalt be defiled by the flesh of man; and before their faces thou shalt be made unclean.”
And the Lord said, “Thus shall the children of Israel eat their bread unclean among the nations.”

And I said, “O Lord God of Israel! This is not acceptable; behold, my body has not been defiled; from my youth until this day, I have not eaten that which is torn by beasts; nor has any unclean flesh entered my mouth.”
And He said, “Behold, I have given thee the fat of the beast in the flesh of man; and in it thou shalt eat thy bread.”
Moreover, He said to me, “O son of man! I will break the bread of Jerusalem with a balance; in their distress they shall eat their bread, and in their hunger they shall drink water in measure;
that they may eat bread and drink water, and that they may be confounded one with another, and that they may perish in their iniquities.”

sections.title: Ezekiel, a sign shall be made, the burning of the thornbush.

verses.text: "O son of man! Rather than being a burden to yourself, take upon yourself the yoke of righteousness; and bear your own head and your own shame; also take the balance; and you shall be weighed in the scales."

"And when your days of captivity are fulfilled, you shall be consumed by fire in the midst of the city; and you shall take your fire and strike it around; and you shall blow your fire into the wind; and I will follow behind you with fire."
"Then take the few in number; and in your hiding place, they shall be counted."
"And among them also, you shall be consumed in the fire; and you shall be burned in the fire; and from her shall come forth fire; and you shall say to all the house of Israel, thus."
"Thus says the Lord God: This is Jerusalem; I have set her in the midst of the nations and the countries that are round about her."

"And she has forsaken her judgments more than the nations; and she has cast aside my commandments more than all the countries that are round about her; for she has rejected my judgments, and they have not walked in my commandments."

"Therefore, thus says the Lord God: Behold, I have gathered you unto the nations that are round about you; and you have not walked in my commandments, nor have you kept my judgments; and you have not done according to the judgments of the nations that are round about you."
"Therefore, thus says the Lord God: Behold, I am against you; and I will execute judgment in the midst of you in the sight of the nations."
"Concerning your abominations, all that I did not do, I will do; and that which resembles Him, I will also do."

"Therefore, in the midst of you, fathers shall eat their children; and children shall eat their fathers; and I will execute judgment upon you; and all that remains of you, I will scatter to all the winds."
Therefore, I am alive, and because of your pride and your arrogance in defiling my sanctuary, truly I shall bring you low, saith the Lord God; and mine eyes shall not spare, neither will I have pity.

And from you, the slain shall fall; in the midst of you, the hungry shall not be satisfied; the slain shall fall around you by the sword; and I will send the sword against all the winds; and behind them, I will draw the sword.
"I will pour out my fury and my wrath upon them; and my wrath shall be known when I execute judgments upon them, as I have spoken."
And I will destroy you in the midst of the nations, and among those that pass by, I will make you a desolation before your children.
In my fury and in my wrath, when I have executed my judgments upon you, I will make you a desolation among the nations; you shall be desolate; I, the Lord God, have spoken this."

To destroy that which is destined for destruction, and to consume that which I have sent against you, when I send forth the famine upon you, I will increase your hunger; and I will break your bread into pieces.

I will send forth the beasts of the field against you, and they shall bereave you; I will send the sword against your children, and blood shall come upon you; and I will bring the sword upon you; they shall be your terror. I, the Lord God, have spoken this."

sections.title: The Lord shall remove the idols as one removes the dust.

verses.text: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying:
"O son of man, set thy face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy against them."

"Hear the word of the Lord God concerning the mountains of Israel; thus saith the Lord God to the mountains and to the hills, to the rivers and to the valleys: Behold, I will bring a sword upon you, and I will destroy your high places."
"And your altars shall be desolate; and your images shall be broken; and I will cast down your slain men before your idols."
"And I will lay the dead bodies of the children of Israel before their idols; and I will scatter your bones round about your altars."

"In all your dwelling places the cities shall be laid waste, and the high places shall be desolate; that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your images may be cut down, and your works may be abolished."
"And the slain shall fall in the midst of you, and ye shall know that I am the Lord."
"Yet, when I have cast you out among the nations, and scattered you in the countries, I will be unto you as a refuge."

"And when you are taken captive among the nations, and when you are scattered in the lands, I will remember you; for your heart shall be troubled, and your soul shall be vexed, and your eyes shall weep for your idols, and you shall be ashamed of all your works."
"And I am the Lord; you shall know that I am the Lord, and this evil I will do unto them shall not be in vain."

The Lord saith, "With thine hand thou shalt smite; and with thy foot thou shalt trample; for all the wickedness concerning the house of Israel, woe, woe shall be spoken; by the sword and by the battle, they shall be consumed."

"He that is far off shall die by the sword; and he that is near shall fall by the sword; and he that remaineth in the land and is honored shall perish by famine; thus will I execute my vengeance upon them."

"Their heads shall be among their idols and round about their altars in the day of their downfall; in the mountains and in all the hills, and under every green tree, in the place of their idols, they shall know that I am the Lord when I have brought them low."
"And I will stretch out my hand upon them; and in all the places where they dwell, I will make the land desolate, more than the wilderness toward Diblath; and they shall know that I am the Lord."

sections.title: The Deliverance of Israel

verses.text: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying thus:
"Thou, O son of man! Thus saith the Lord God concerning the land of Israel: The end hath come upon the land of Israel; the end hath come upon the four corners of the land.
Now the end is come upon thee, and I will send my anger upon thee; according to thy ways will I judge thee; and all thine abominations will I bring upon thee.
Mine eye shall not spare thee, neither will I have pity; but I will bring thy ways upon thee, and thine iniquity shall be in the midst of thee; and I am the Lord God, and ye shall know it.
Thus saith the Lord God, "Evil upon evil; behold, it shall come.
The end is come; the end is come; it awakeneth against thee; behold, it hath come.
O thou that dwellest in the land! The time of thy punishment hath come; the day is near; it is a day of trouble, and not a day of rejoicing upon the mountains.
Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon thee; and I will accomplish my anger upon thee; according to thy ways will I judge thee; and all thine abominations will I bring upon thee.
Mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity; but I will bring thy ways upon thee, and thine iniquity shall be in the midst of thee; and I am the Lord God, and ye shall know it.
"Behold, the day is come; behold! The day of the Lord cometh; thy punishment is come; if thou dost not repent, it shall be revealed; and thy iniquity shall be increased."
የኀጢአተኛው ምርኩዝ ተሰበረ፤ በደል በዛች፤ ይኸውም በሁከት አይደለም፤ በችኮላም አይደለም።
ጊዜው መጥቶአል፤ ቀኑ እነሆ ቀርቦአል፤ መቅሠፍቷ በሁለንተናዋ መልቶአልና የሚገዛ ደስ አይበለው፤ የሚሸጥም አይዘን።
የገዛው ወደ ሻጩ አይመለስም፤ ዳግመኛም በሕይወት ይኖራል፤ ሁለንተናዋን አይቶአልና አልተመለሰም፤ የሰው ሕይወቱ በዐይኑ ፊት ነው።
“መለከቱን ንፉ፤ ሁሉንም አዘጋጁ፤ ነገር ግን መዓቴ በብዙዎች ሁሉ ላይ ነውና ወደ ሰልፍ የሚሄድ የለም።
ሰይፍ በውጭ፥ ቸነፈርና ራብ በውስጥ አለ፤ በሜዳ ያለው በሰይፍ ይሞታል፤ በከተማም ያለውን ቸነፈርና ራብ ይፈጁታል።
ከእነርሱም የሚሸሹ ይድናሉ፤ መብረርን እንደሚማር ርግብም በተራራ ላይ ይሆናሉ፤ እኔም በኀጢአታቸው ሁሉ እገድላለሁ።
እጅ ሁሉ ትደክማለች፤ ጕልበትም ሁሉ እንደ ውኃ ይሆናል።
ማቅም ትታጠቃላችሁ፤ ድንጋጤም ይሸፍናችኋል፤ በፊትም ሁሉ ላይ ሐፍረት ይሆናል፤ በራሳችሁም ሁሉ ላይ ቡሃነት ይሆናል።
ብራቸውን በጎዳናዎቹ ላይ ይጥላሉ፤ ወርቃቸውም ይረክሳል፤ በእግዚአብሔር መዓት ቀን ብራቸውና ወርቃቸው አያድናቸውም። እርሱ የኀጢአታቸው እንቅፋት ሆኖአልና ሰውነታቸውን አያጠግቡም፤ ሆዳቸውንም አይሞሉም።
የክብሩንም ጌጥ ወደ ትዕቢት ለወጡ፤ የርኵስነታቸውንም ምስሎች አደረጉባት፤ ስለዚህ እኔ በእነርሱ ዘንድ ርኩስ አድርጌአታለሁ።
I will stretch out My hand against the inhabitants of the land, and against the sinners of the earth I will lay My hand, and they shall be brought low.
I will turn My face away from them; they shall be ashamed of their iniquities; the mighty shall be brought low; they shall be humbled.
"The earth has turned over because of the nations, and the city has been turned back because of sin, and the work of iniquity is upon it."
I will bring forth all that which is abominable from among the nations; their houses shall be desolate, and I will put an end to the pride of the mighty; their sanctuaries shall be forsaken.
Destruction has come; peace has fled; and he shall not be found.
Stone shall come upon stone; woe shall follow woe; the prophet shall be ashamed of his vision; the priest shall be ashamed of the law, and the elders shall lose their counsel.

The king shall be stripped, and the leader shall be clothed in shame; the people of the earth shall be brought low; according to their ways I will deal with them; according to their judgments I will judge them; and I am the Lord God, and they shall know that I am."

sections.title: A prayer in the temple in Jerusalem.

verses.text: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በስድስተኛው ዓመት በስድስተኛው ወር ከወሩም በአምስተኛው ቀን በቤቴ ተቀምጬ ሳለሁ፥ የይሁዳም ሽማግሌዎች በፊቴ ተቀምጠው ሳሉ፥ በዚያ የጌታ የእግዚአብሔር እጅ በላዬ መጣ።
እኔም አየሁ፤ እነሆም ከወገቡ በታች እንደ እሳት የሚመስል የሰው አምሳያ ነበረ፤ ከወገቡም ወደ ላይ እንደ ፀዳል ምሳሌ፥ እንደሚያንጸባርቅ አይነት ነበረ።
እጅ መሳይንም ዘረጋ፤ በራስ ጠጕሬም ያዘኝ፤ መንፈስም በምድርና በሰማይ መካከል አነሣኝ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ራእይ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ሰሜን ወደሚመለከተው ወደ ውስጠኛው አደባባይ በር መግቢያ ቅንአት የተባለው ምስል ወደ አለበት አመጣኝ፤
እነሆም ቀድሞ በሜዳ እንደ አየሁት ራእይ የእስራኤል አምላክ ክብር በዚያ ነበረ።
እርሱም፥ “የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! ዐይንህን ወደ ሰሜን መንገድ አንሣ” አለኝ። ዐይኔንም ወደ ሰሜን መንገድ አነሣሁ፤ እነሆም በመሠዊያው በር በሰሜን በኩል በመግቢያው ይህ የቅንዓት ምስል ነበረ። ከዚያም ወደ ምሥራቅ ያስገባል።
እርሱም፥ “የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! የሚያደርጉትን ከመቅደሴ ያርቁኝ ዘንድ የእስራኤል ቤት በዚህ የሚያደርጉትን፥ ታላቁን ርኵሰት ታያለህን? ደግሞም ተመልሰህ ከዚህ የበለጠ ታላቅ ርኵሰት ታያለህ” አለኝ።
ወደ አደባባዩም መግቢያ አስገባኝ፤ በአየሁም ጊዜ፥ እነሆ በግንቡ ውስጥ ፉካ ነበረ።
እርሱም፥ “የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! ግንቡን ንደለው” አለኝ፤ ግንቡንም በነደልሁት ጊዜ ደጃፍ አገኘሁ።
እርሱም፥ “ግባ፤ በዚህ የሚያደርጉትን ክፉውን ርኵሰት እይ” አለኝ።
እኔም ገባሁና፥ እነሆ በግንቡ ዙሪያ ላይ የተንቀሳቃሾች አዕዋፍና እንስሳትን ምሳሌ ከንቱና ርኩስ የእስራኤልንም ቤት ጣዖታት ሁሉ ተሥለው አየሁ።
And before them stood seven men of the house of Israel, and among them was Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan; and every man had his censer in his hand, and the smoke of the incense went up.

And He said unto me, “Son of man, dost thou not see what the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in the chambers of his imagery? For they say, ‘The Lord seeth us not; the Lord hath forsaken the earth.’”
And He said unto me, “Thou shalt see greater abominations that they do.”
And He brought me to the door of the north gate of the Lord's house; and behold, there sat women weeping for Tammuz.
And He said unto me, “Son of man, dost thou not see this? Thou shalt see yet greater abominations than these.”

And He brought me into the inner court of the Lord's house, and behold, at the entrance of the temple of the Lord, between the porch and the altar, were about twenty-five men, with their backs toward the temple of the Lord, and their faces toward the east; and they worshipped the sun toward the east.

And He said unto me, “Son of man, dost thou not see what they do? Even the great abominations that the house of Judah commit here, to cause me to go far off from my sanctuary? For they have filled the land with violence, and have returned to provoke me to anger; and lo, they put the branch to their nose.”
Therefore will I also deal in fury; mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity; and though they cry in mine ears with a loud voice, yet will I not hear them.”

sections.title: The Destruction of Jerusalem

verses.text: እርሱም፥ “እያንዳንዳቸው የሚያጠፉባት መሣሪያን በእጃቸው ይዘው ከተማዪቱን የሚቀሥፉ ይቅረቡ” ብሎ በታላቅ ድምፅ በጆሮዬ ጮኸ።
እነሆም እያንዳንዳቸው ገጀሞ መሣሪያ በእጃቸው ይዘው ስድስት ሰዎች ወደ ሰሜን ከሚመለከተው ከላይኛው በር መንገድ መጡ፤ በመካከላቸውም የበፍታ ልብስ የለበሰና የሰንፔር መታጠቂያ በወገቡ የታጠቀ አንድ ሰው ነበረ። እነርሱም ገብተው በናሱ መሠዊያ አጠገብ ቆሙ።
የእስራኤልም አምላክ ክብር በበላዩ ከነበረበት ኪሩብ ተነሥቶ ወደ ቤቱ መድረክ ሄዶ ነበር፤ በፍታም የለበሰውን፥ የሰንፔር መታጠቂያም በወገቡ የታጠቀውን ሰው ጠራ።
እግዚአብሔርም፥ “በከተማዪቱ በኢየሩሳሌም መካከል እለፍ፥ በመካከልዋም ስለ ተሠራው ኀጢአት ሁሉ በሚያለቅሱና በሚተክዙ ሰዎች ግንባር ላይ ምልክት ጻፍ አለው።
እኔም እየሰማሁ ለሌሎቹ፦ በስተኋላው ወደ ከተማው ግቡ፤ ግደሉም፤ ዐይናችሁ አይራራ፤ ይቅርም አትበሉ፤
ሽማግሌውንና ጎበዙን፥ ድንግሊቱንም፥ ሕፃናቱንና ሴቶቹን፥ ፈጽማችሁ ግደሉ፤ ነገር ግን ምልክቱ ወደ አለበት ሰው ሁሉ አትቅረቡ፤ በመቅደሴም ጀምሩ” አላቸው። በቤቱም አንጻር ባሉ ሽማግሌዎች ጀመሩ።
እርሱም፥ “ቤቱን አርክሱ፤ ወጥታችሁ ግደሉ፤ በሙታንም መንገዶችን ሙሉ” አላቸው።
ሲገድሉም እኔ ብቻዬን ቀርቼ ሳለሁ በግንባሬ ተደፍቼ፥ “ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ! ወዮ! መዓትህን በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ ስታፈስስ የእስራኤልን ቅሬታ ሁሉ ታጠፋለህን?” ብዬ ጮኽሁ።
እርሱም፥ “የእስራኤልና የይሁዳ ቤት ኀጢአት እጅግ በዝቶአል፤ ምድሪቱም በብዙ አሕዛብ እንደ ተመላች ከተማዪቱም እንዲሁ ዓመፅንና ርኵሰትን ተሞልታለች፤ እነርሱም፦ እግዚአብሔር ምድሪቱን ትቶአታል፤ እግዚአብሔርም አያይም” ብለዋል።
“እኔም ደግሞ በዐይኔ አልራራም፤ ይቅርታም አላደርግም፤ መንገዳቸውንም በራሳቸው ላይ እመልሳለሁ” አለኝ።
Behold, he who was clothed in rags, and the man who had been cleansed with soap came forth, saying, "I will do as you have commanded me," and he returned with these words.

sections.title: The glory of the Lord arose from the house of the temple.

verses.text: And I beheld; and, lo, there appeared a likeness as the appearance of a throne, like a sapphire stone, upon the cherubim.

And he spake unto me, saying, “Enter between the cherubim, and beneath the cherubim; and fill thy hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim, and scatter them over the city.” And I went in as he commanded me.
And when the man went in, the cherub stood on the right side of the house; and the cloud filled the inner court.
And the glory of the Lord went up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the Lord's glory.
And the voice of the cherubim was heard even unto the outer court, as the voice of the Almighty God when he speaketh.
And he spake unto the man clothed in linen, and said, “Go in between the wheels, even under the cherub, and fill thy hands with fire from between the cherubim.” And he went in as he commanded.

And one cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubim unto the fire that was between the cherubim, and took thereof, and put it into the hands of him that was clothed with linen; and he took it, and went out.
And I looked, and behold, there was one cherub, and under him were the hands of a man.

And I looked, and behold, four cherubim stood by it; and one cherub was by one cherub, and another cherub was by another cherub. And the appearance of the cherubim was as the appearance of a stone of beryl.
And the appearance of the four was one likeness; and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.

And they were to go in the four directions. And as they went, they did not turn this way or that; they went straight to the place where they were to face. And as they went, they did not turn this way or that.
Their bodies, and their backs, and their hands; their wings also, and their faces; the four living creatures that were around them were filled with eyes all around.
And the four living creatures, as I heard, were called Cherubim.
And to each one there were four faces; the first face was that of a cherub, the second face was that of a man, the third face was that of a lion, and the fourth face was that of an eagle.
And these were seen by the river Kebar, as I beheld the cherubim, and they were flying.
And as the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them; and when the cherubim lifted up their wings to ascend from the earth, the wheels did not turn from beside them.
The spirit of life was within them, and when these stood, those also stood; and when these were lifted up, those were lifted up with them.
And the glory of the Lord went up from the threshold of the house and stood over the cherubim.

And the cherubim lifted up their wings, and I looked, and they were lifted up from the earth; and in the going forth, the wheels were beside them; they stood at the entrance of the house of the Lord, facing each other at the entrance; and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.
This was the living creature that I saw beneath the God of Israel by the river Kebar; and I knew that they were cherubim.
For each one, there were four faces, and for each one, there were four wings; and the hands of a man were beneath their wings on their four sides.
And their faces were like the faces which I had seen by the river Chebar, the glory of the God of Israel; and they had the same appearance, and each one went straight forward.

sections.title: A judgment that was pronounced over Jerusalem.

verses.text: And the Spirit lifted me up; and it brought me to the east, to the gate of the house of the Lord, which looketh eastward. And behold, at the entrance of the gate there stood twenty-five men; among them I saw the princes of the people, the son of Azur, and the son of Pelatiah, the son of Benaiah.
And He said unto me, “O son of man! These are the men that devise mischief, and give wicked counsel in this city.”
And they said, “Are not the houses of these in the midst of the land? This city is the cauldron, and we be the flesh.”
Therefore, O son of man! Prophesy against them; prophesy, and say unto them.”
And the Spirit of the Lord fell upon me, and He said unto me, “Speak; thus saith the Lord God: O house of Israel! I have spoken against you; I know the things that are upon your hearts.”
In this city have ye multiplied your slain; and in your streets are your dead.
Therefore, thus saith the Lord God: The slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it, they are the flesh; and this city is the cauldron; but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it.
Ye shall fall by the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you, saith the Lord God.
And I will bring you forth out of the midst of it; and I will deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments upon you.
Ye shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the borders of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the Lord God.
This city shall not be a desolation unto you; and ye shall not be as flesh in its midst; for I will judge you upon the mountains of Israel; and I am the Lord your God, as ye shall know.
For ye have not walked in My commandment, neither have ye executed My judgments; and I have made you as the law of the nations that dwell round about you.
And when I prophesied, the son of Benaias fell dead; and I was seized with terror, and I cried out with a loud voice, “O Lord God! Woe! Woe unto me! Truly, wilt Thou destroy the cry of Israel?”

sections.title: The Lord is the hope granted to the exiles.

verses.text: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:

"O son of man! Those who dwell in Jerusalem: distance yourselves from the Lord; for this land is given as an inheritance to us, say your brothers and your contemporaries, and all your people of the house of Israel shall be cut off."
Therefore, thus says the Lord God: "I will gather them from the nations; and I will bring them to their lands; yet I will be a small sanctuary for them in the countries where they have come."
Therefore, thus says the Lord God: "I will accept them from the nations; and I will gather them from the countries where they have been scattered; and I will give them the land of Israel."
And they shall come there; and they shall cast away all their abominations and all their transgressions from them.
I will give them one heart; and I will put a new spirit within them; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and I will give them a heart of flesh;
that they may walk in My statutes and keep My judgments and do them; and they shall be My people, and I will be their God.
"And when their hearts go after their idols, and when they walk in their iniquities, I will return their way upon their own heads," says the Lord God.

sections.title: The glory of the Lord shall rise from Jerusalem.

verses.text: And the cherubim had their wings spread out, and the seraphim were beside them; the glory of the God of Israel was above them.
And the glory of the Lord rose up from the midst of the city and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city.
And the Spirit lifted me up; and in the Spirit of the Lord, in vision, He brought me to the land of the Chaldeans, to the place of the captives.
And what I saw was a vision that went forth from me. And all that the Lord showed me, I spoke to the captives.

sections.title: The prophet as a stranger.

verses.text: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
"O son of man! You dwell in the midst of a rebellious house; they have eyes to see, but they do not see; they have ears to hear, but they do not hear; for they are a rebellious house."

"And you, O son of man! Prepare for yourself an exile's baggage, and in their sight, day by day, you shall go into exile; and in their sight, from one place to another, you shall move; and they shall know that they are a rebellious house."
"In their sight, you shall bring forth your baggage as an exile's baggage, and at evening, as they watch you, you shall go out like an exile."
"In their sight, you shall dig through the wall and go out through it."

"And for the house of Israel, I have made you a sign; and in their sight, you shall bear your burden upon your shoulder; and in darkness, you shall go out; you shall cover your face, that you may not see the land."

"As I commanded you, so I did; day by day, I brought forth my burden as an exile's burden; and at evening, I dug through the wall with my hand; in darkness, I went out; and in their sight, I bore my burden upon my shoulder."
And in the evening, the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
"O son of man! What is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel, saying, 'The days are prolonged, and every vision fails'?"
"You shall say to them, 'Thus says the Lord God: This proverb shall no more be used by you in Israel; but say to them, "The days are at hand, and the fulfillment of every vision is at hand."'"
ደግሞም፦ እኔ ምልክታችሁ ነኝ፤ እኔ እንዳደረግሁ እንዲሁ ይደረግባቸዋል፥ እነርሱንም ማርከው ይወስዷቸዋል በል።
በመካከላቸውም የሚኖረው አለቃ በትከሻው ላይ አንግቶ በጨለማ ይወጣል፤ በዚያ ያወጡ ዘንድ ግንቡን ይነድላሉ፤ በዐይኑም ምድርን እንዳያይ ፊቱን ይሸፍናል።
መረቤንም በእርሱ ላይ እዘረጋለሁ፤ በወጥመዴም ይያዛል፤ ወደ ከለዳውያንም ምድር ወደ ባቢሎን አመጣዋለሁ፤ ሆኖም አያያትም፤ በዚያም ይሞታል።
የሚረዱትንም፥ በዙሪያው ያሉትን ሁሉ፥ ጭፍሮቹንም ሁሉ ወደ ነፋሳት ሁሉ እበትናቸዋለሁ፤ በኋላቸውም ሰይፍን እመዝዛለሁ።
በአሕዛብም መካከል በምበትናቸው ጊዜ፥ በሀገሮችም በምዘራቸው ጊዜ፥ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።
በሚሄዱባቸውም አሕዛብ መካከል ርኵሰታቸውን ሁሉ ይናገሩ ዘንድ ከሰይፍና ከራብ፥ ከቸነፈርም ጥቂቶች ሰዎችን ከእነርሱ አስቀራለሁ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።”
የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፦
“የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! እንጀራህን በመታወክ ብላ፤ ውኃህንም በፍርሃትና በድንጋጤ ጠጣ፤
ለምድሪቱም ሕዝብ፦ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በኢየሩሳሌም ስለሚኖሩ ስለ እስራኤል ምድርም እንዲህ ይላል፦ የሚኖሩባት ሁሉ በዐመፅ ይኖራሉና ምድሪቱ በመላዋ ትጠፋ ዘንድ እንጀራቸውን በችግር ይበላሉ፤ ውኃቸውንም በድንጋጤ ይጠጣሉ።
ሰዎች የሚኖሩባቸው ከተሞች ይጠፋሉ፤ ምድሪቱም ውድማ ትሆናለች፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ በላቸው።”
And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying thus:
"O son of man! In the land of Israel: the time is drawing near; and all visions shall cease, what is the parable that you speak of?"
Therefore, thus saith the Lord God: "I have set forth this parable; and in Israel also, they shall not speak parables; but you, behold, all that is to come and all that they have seen is at an end."
After this, there shall be no vain vision nor flattering divination in the house of Israel.
"I am the Lord; I will speak, and the word that I speak shall come to pass; and it shall not be delayed; O house of Israel, I will speak my word in your time; I will perform it," saith the Lord God.
And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying thus:
"O son of man! The house of Israel, the desolate one: this vision is for many days; and he shall prophesy for a long time to come."
Therefore, they say unto them, "Thus saith the Lord God: the word that I speak shall come to pass; but concerning all my words, there shall be none that shall be delayed," saith the Lord God.

sections.title: The prophecy that was spoken concerning the false prophets.

verses.text: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፦
“የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! ትንቢት በሚናገሩ በእስራኤል ነቢያት ላይ ትንቢት ተናገር፤ ከገዛ ልባቸውም ትንቢት የሚናገሩትን፦ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ በላቸው፤
ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ ፈጽሞ ሳያዩ ከገዛ ልባቸው አንቅተው ትንቢት ለሚናገሩ ወዮላቸው!
እስራኤል ሆይ! ነቢያትህ በምድረ በዳ እንደሚኖሩ ቀበሮዎች ናቸው።
ወደ ተሰበረው ቅጥር አልወጣችሁም፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ቀን በሰልፍ ትቆሙ ዘንድ ለእስራኤል ቤት ቅጥርን አልሠራችሁም።
እግዚአብሔር ሳይልካቸው፦ እግዚአብሔር ይላል የሚሉ ሰዎች ሐሰትን ያያሉ፤ ከንቱን ያምዋርታሉ፤ ቃሉንም ማጽናት ይጀምራሉ።
እኔም ሳልናገር፦ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሎአል ስትሉ፥ ከንቱ ምዋርትን የተናገራችሁ፥ የሐሰት ራእይንም ያያችሁ አይደላችሁምን?”
ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፥ “ከንቱ ነገርን ስለ ተናገራችሁ፥ ሐሰተኛ ራእይንም ስለ አያችሁ፥ ስለዚህ እነሆ እኔ በእናንተ ላይ ነኝ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
እጄም ሐሰተኛ ራእይን በሚያዩ፥ ሕዝቤንም ለማታለል በከንቱ በሚያምዋርቱ ነቢያት ላይ ትሆናለች። እነርሱም በሕዝቤ ማኅበር ውስጥ አይኖሩም፤ በእስራኤልም ቤት መጽሐፍ አይጻፉም፥ ወደ እስራኤልም ምድር አይገቡም፤ እኔም ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።
ሰላም ሳይኖር፦ ሰላም እያሉ ሕዝቤን አታልለዋልና፤ አንዱም ሰው ቅጥር ሲሠራ እነርሱ ያለገለባ ይመርጉታል፤ ይወድቃልም፤

For those who are without understanding, they shall be brought low; the rain that falls upon them shall be a deluge; and I will bring upon them a great hailstone upon their own heads; and they shall be brought low; the mighty whirlwind shall sweep them away.
Behold, when the wall has fallen, where is the refuge you have chosen? Will you not say unto yourselves?
Therefore, saith the Lord God, thus shall I speak: By my wind shall I sweep them away; and the rain that falls in my wrath shall be a deluge; and I will bring upon them a great hailstone in my time.

I will break down the wall that you have chosen; it shall be brought low; and I will cast it to the ground; its foundation shall be seen; it shall tremble; and in the midst of it, you shall perish; and I am the Lord God, and you shall know me.
In my time, I shall act upon the wall, and upon those who are without understanding; the wall shall be brought low; and I shall say unto you: The wall and its builders are no more.
They shall prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and the prophets of Israel shall see the vision of peace; and they shall say, "There is no peace," saith the Lord God.

sections.title: The word concerning the prophets of the deceitful women.

verses.text: "And you, O son of man! Set your face against the daughters of your people, who prophesy out of their own hearts; prophesy against them."

"And thus say unto them: Thus saith the Lord God: Woe unto the women that sew pillows to all armholes, and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls! Will ye hunt the souls of my people, and will ye save the souls alive that come unto you?"
"Ye have slain the souls that should not die, and have saved the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to my people that hear your lies."

"Therefore thus saith the Lord God: Behold, I am against your pillows, wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make them fly; and I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go, even the souls that ye hunt to make them fly."
"Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand; and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and ye shall know that I am the Lord."

"Because ye have spoken vanity, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you, saith the Lord God; and mine hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the assembly of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the Lord God."

"Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and there was no peace; and one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered mortar: say unto them which daub it with untempered mortar, that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and ye, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend it."

sections.title: The idols of the gods have been cast down.

verses.text: And the elders of Israel came to me and sat before me.
And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
"Son of man! These men have set up their idols in their hearts, and have put the stumbling block of their iniquity before their faces; should I be inquired of at all by them?

Therefore speak unto them, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God: Every man of the house of Israel that setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet; I the Lord will answer him that cometh according to the multitude of his idols.
And this is to make the house of Israel remember, as they have separated themselves from me, according to their hearts and according to their abominations.
Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God: Repent, and turn yourselves from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.

And if any of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, separate themselves from me, and set up their idols in their hearts, and put the stumbling block of their iniquity before their faces, and come to a prophet to inquire of me, I the Lord will answer him by myself.
And I will set my face against that man, and will make him a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of my people; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.
And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing, I the Lord have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.
And they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity; the iniquity of the prophet shall be even as the iniquity of him that seeketh unto him.
"And thus shall the house of Israel say, 'Let them not be far from me, lest they perish in all their iniquities; they shall be a people, and I will be their God,' saith the Lord God."
"And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,"

"O son of man! If the land were to sin against me, and if it were to transgress, I would stretch out my hand against it; I would destroy its strength, and I would send famine upon it; I would cut off man and beast from it."
"Though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they would deliver but their own souls by their righteousness," saith the Lord God.
"If I bring a sword upon that land, and say, 'Sword, go through the land,' and cut off man and beast from it,"
"Though these three men were in the midst of it, I live! They would deliver only their own souls, but they would not deliver sons and daughters; the land would be desolate," saith the Lord God.
"Or if I bring a sword upon that land, saying, 'Sword, go through the land,' and cut off man and beast from it,"
"Though these three men were in the midst of it, I live! They would deliver only their own souls, but they would not deliver sons and daughters," saith the Lord God.
"Or if I bring a pestilence upon that land, and pour out my fury upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast,"
"Though Noah, Daniel, and Job were in the midst of it, I live! They would deliver but their own souls by their righteousness; they would not deliver sons and daughters," saith the Lord God.
Thus saith the Lord God, “Indeed, I will bring upon Jerusalem the four evil judgments: the sword, and famine, and evil beasts, and pestilence, to cut off man and beast from it.”

“Nevertheless, behold, those who escape and the men and women who bring forth children shall remain; behold, they shall go forth unto you; and you shall see their way and their doings; for all the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, because of all that I have brought upon it, you shall be comforted.”
“Their way and their doings shall be a comfort to you in your time; and you shall know that all that I have done unto them was not in vain,” saith the Lord God.

sections.title: The Parable of the Vineyard.

verses.text: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፦
“የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! የወይን ግንድ ከዱር ዛፎች ሁሉና ከዱር ዛፎች ቅርንጫፎች ሁሉ ይልቅ ብልጫው ምንድን ነው?
በውኑ ሥራ የሚሠራበትን እንጨት ከእርሱ ይወስዳሉን? ወይስ ሰዎች ዕቃ የሚንጠለጠልበትን ኩላብ ከእርሱ ይወስዳሉን?
እነሆ ለመቃጠል በእሳት ላይ ተጥሎአል፤ እሳቱም ሁለቱን ጫፎቹን በልቶአል፤ መካከሉም ተቃጥሎአል፤ በውኑ ለሥራ ይጠቅማልን?
ከውፍረቱም የተነሣ ለሥራ አይሆንም፤ ለምትበላና ለምታጠፋ እሳት ይሆናል እንጂ ከዚያ በኋላ በውኑ ለሥራ ይሆናልን?
ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ በዱር ዛፎች መካከል ያለውን የወይን ግንድ እሳት ይበላው ዘንድ እንደ ሰጠሁት፥ እንዲሁ በኢየሩሳሌም የሚኖሩትን አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ።
ፊቴንም በእነርሱ ላይ አጸናለሁ፤ ከእሳትም አይወጡም፤ እሳትም ይበላቸዋል፤ ፊቴንም በእነርሱ ላይ በአጸናሁ ጊዜ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።
ዐመፅን አድርገዋልና ምድሪቱን ባድማ አደርጋለሁ፥” ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

sections.title: Faith has been established in Jerusalem.

verses.text: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፦
“የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! ለኢየሩሳሌም ኀጢአትዋን አስታውቃት፤ እንዲህም በላት፦
ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ለኢየሩሳሌም እንዲህ ይላል፦ ዘርሽና ትውልድሽ ከከነዓን ምድር ነው፤ አባትሽ አሞራዊ ነበረ፤ እናትሽም ኬጢያዊት ነበረች።
በተወለድሽ ጊዜ በዚያው ቀን እትብትሽ አልታተበም፤ ንጹሕም ትሆኚ ዘንድ በውኃ አልታጠብሽም፤ በጨውም አልተወለወልሽም፤ በጨርቅም አልተጠቀለልሽም፤ በጭንም አልታቀፍሽም።
በተወለድሽበት ቀን ከሰውነትሽ ጕስቍልና የተነሣ በሜዳ ላይ ተጣልሽ እንጂ፥ ከዚህ አንዳች ይደረግልሽ ዘንድ ዐይኔ አልራራልሽም፤ ማንም አላዘነልሽም።
“በአንቺም ዘንድ ባለፍሁ ጊዜ፤ በደምሽም ተለውሰሽ በአየሁሽ ጊዜ፦ ከደምሽ ዳኝ አልሁሽ፤
በእርሻ ላይ እንደ አለ ቡቃያ አበዛሁሽ፤ አንቺም አደግሽ፤ ታላቅም ሆንሽ፤ በእጅጉም አጌጥሽ፤ ከከተማ ወደ ከተማ ገባሽ፤ ጡቶችሽም አጐጠጐጡ፤ ጠጕርሽም አደገ፤ ነገር ግን ዕርቃንሽን ሆንሽ፤ ተራቍተሽም ነበርሽ።
በአንቺ ዘንድ በአለፍሁና በአየሁሽ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ ጊዜሽ እንደ ደረሰ፥ በአንቺም የሚያድሩ ሰዎች ጊዜ እንደ ደረሰ አየሁ። እጆችን በላይሽ ዘረጋሁ፤ ኀፍረተ ሥጋሽንም ከደንሁ፤ ማልሁልሽም፤ ከአንቺም ጋራ ቃል ኪዳን ገባሁ፥” ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ አንቺም ለእኔ ሆንሽ።
በውኃም አጠብሁሽ፤ ከደምሽም አጠራሁሽ፤ በዘይትም ቀባሁሽ።
ወርቀ ዘቦም አለበስሁሽ፤ ጥቁር ጫማም አደረግሁልሽ፤ በጥሩ በፍታ አስታጠቅሁሽ፤ በሐርም ከደንሁሽ።
በጌጥም አስጌጥሁሽ፤ በእጅሽም ላይ አንባር፥ በአንገትሽም ላይ ድሪ አደረግሁልሽ።
በአፍንጫሽም ቀለበት፥ በጆሮሽም ጉትቻ፥ በራስሽም ላይ የክብር አክሊል አደረግሁ።
በወርቅና በብር አጌጥሽ፤ ልብስሽም ጥሩ በፍታና ሐር፥ ወርቀ ዘቦም ነበረ፤ አንቺም መልካምን ዱቄትና ማርን፥ ዘይትንም በላሽ፤ ወፈርሽ፤ እጅግም ውብ ሆንሽ፤ ለመንግሥትም የተዘጋጀሽ አደረግሁሽ።
ባንቺ ላይ ከአኖርኋት ከክብሬ የተነሣ ውበትሽ ፍጹም ነበረና ስምሽ በአሕዛብ መካከል ተሰማ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።
“ነገር ግን በውበትሽ ታምነሻል፤ በስምሽም አመንዝረሻል፤ ምንዝርናሽንም ከመንገድ አላፊ ሁሉ ጋር አበዛሽ።
ከልብስሽም ወስደሽ በመርፌ የተጠለፉ ጣዖታትን ሠራሽ፤ አመነዘርሽባቸውም፤ ስለዚህ ፈጽመሽ አልገባሽም፤ ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ እንዲህ ያለ ነገር አይሆንም።
ከሰጠሁሽም ከወርቄና ከብሬ የተሠራውን የክብርሽን ዕቃ ወስደሽ የወንድ ምስሎችን ለራስሽ አድርገሻል፤ አመንዝረሽባቸውማል።
ወርቀ ዘቦውን ልብስሽንም ወስደሽ ደረብሽላቸው፤ ዘይቴንና ዕጣኔንም በፊታቸው አኖርሽ።
የሰጠሁሽንም እንጀራዬን፥ ያበላሁሽንም ዱቄትና ዘይቱን፥ ማሩንም ጣፋጭ ሽታ አድርገሽ በፊታቸው አኖርሽ፤ እንዲህም ሆኖአል፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።
ለእኔም የወለድሻቸውን ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችሽን ወስደሽ መብል ይሆኑ ዘንድ ሠዋሽላቸው፤ ገደልሻቸውም።
Thou hast brought forth children; thou hast given them as a sacrifice to the one who is in distress; in truth, is thy glory not but little?
This shall be the recompense for all thy transgressions and thy iniquities; while thou art yet in thy youth, and thy strength is full, thou dost not remember the days of thy childhood.
"Woe unto thee! Woe unto thee! saith the Lord God."
Build thou a house for thyself, and prepare a place that is high in every corner.
In every way, prepare a place that is high for thyself; beautify thyself; let not thy feet be seen by all who walk the path, and let thy mourning be abundant.
And thy body shall be mingled with the children of thy neighbors, the Egyptians; and thou hast increased thy mourning against me.

Therefore, behold, I have set my hand upon thee; I shall gather thy portion; and to those who seek thee, I have granted permission to return from thy path and to thy sorrow, and to the daughters of the Philistines.
With the children of Assyria, thou hast mingled thyself; and yet thou dost not turn back; thy mourning shall not cease.
Until the land of Canaan and even unto the land of the Chaldeans, thy mourning shall increase. And yet thou dost not turn back.
"All this have I done as the work of a woman; and with the daughters of women have I mingled thrice, what shall I do unto the daughters of women?" saith the Lord God.
In every path, thou hast established a place for thy dwelling; in every junction, thou hast made high thy abode. Thy worth is not as one who is gathered, nor art thou as a common vessel.
Thou art likened to a woman who receives money from her husband and yet is not content.

For all who seek to be adorned, a price shall be given unto them; but thou, for all thy beloved, shalt give thy worth; and with thee, to be adorned, they shall surround thee, for thou shalt bestow upon them a measure of thy grace.
Thy widowhood is distinct from that of other women; none follow after thee in thy mourning; without giving a price, thou art unique in the worth thou dost bestow in this matter.

sections.title: The judgment of the Lord upon Jerusalem.

verses.text: "Therefore, sing! Hear the word of the Lord.
Thus saith the Lord God: I will bring forth your blood upon the ground, and I will make your flesh to be as a garment, and I will reveal your blood upon your children.

Therefore, behold, I will gather your companions together against you; I will gather those who seek your life and those who desire your destruction; they shall be ashamed; and I will reveal your nakedness before them; all shall see your shame.
I will cover you with the blood of the innocent and the slain; I will make your dwelling place a desolation and your blood a witness against you.

I will give them into their hands; they shall destroy your dwelling place; they shall uncover your high places; they shall strip you of your garments; they shall take away your glory; they shall cast off your pride.
Many shall gather against you; they shall strike you with stones; they shall slay you with their swords.
Your houses shall be consumed by fire; many shall perish before them; I will bring your shame upon you; from henceforth you shall not be valued.
I will cast my net upon you; your pride shall be brought low; I will be silent; yet I will not be angry.

You have not remembered the days of your youth; in this matter, I have taken you to task; therefore, behold, I will bring your way upon your own head," saith the Lord God; "and thus shall your sin be upon all your wickedness."

sections.title: Her son, as her mother.

verses.text: "Behold, all that speaks in parables, is as a mother; thus is her son; as it is said in a parable, it shall be likened unto you."

"Thou art the daughter of thy mother, who hateth her husband and her children; thou art the sister of thy sisters, who hate their husbands and their children; your mother was a Hittite, and your father was an Amorite."
"Thy elder sister is Samaria, she who dwelleth with her daughters on thy left hand; and thy younger sister, who dwelleth with her daughters on thy right hand, is Sodom."
"But thou hast not walked in their ways, nor done after their abominations; but as if it were a little thing, thou hast been more corrupt than they in all thy ways."
"I live, saith the Lord God; surely, as thou hast done, so shall Sodom and her daughters not have done; thus saith the Lord God."
"Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters; neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy."
"They were haughty, and committed abomination before me; therefore I took them away as I saw good."
"Samaria hath not committed half of thy sins; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they, and hast justified thy sisters in all thine abominations which thou hast done."
"Now, therefore, the punishment of thy sins is greater than theirs; for thou hast been more abominable than they in all thy ways; and thou shalt bear thy shame, and thy sisters shall be comforted."

"I will bring again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters; and I will bring again the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them."
And thou shalt receive thy punishment, for in the work of thine own hands, thou shalt be confounded.
Thy sisters, even Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former state; Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former state; thou and thy daughters shall return to your former state.
Thy sister Sodom hath not been mentioned in the day of thy pride, for she hath not been compared to thee.

Thy wickedness is as the day of today, that it may not be revealed to the daughters of Syria and to all her neighbors; for it hath become a reproach to the daughters of the Philistines round about thee.
Thy iniquity and thy transgressions have been laid bare, saith the Lord God.

sections.title: The everlasting covenant.

verses.text: "Thus saith the Lord God: O thou who dost break the covenant, how dost thou deceive! Even as thou hast done, so will I also do unto thee."
"But I remember the covenant which I made with thee in the days of thy youth; and I will establish unto thee the everlasting covenant."
"When thou didst receive thy sisters, the great and the small, thou didst remember thy way; thou wast ashamed; and for thy children I will give them, but concerning thy covenant, it shall not be."
"And I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord God."

"Remember, therefore, and be ashamed; and for all that thou hast done, let it be a time of repentance; for concerning thy transgressions, thou shalt not be able to open thy mouth." Thus saith the Lord God.

sections.title: Chapter 17.
The parable of the vine and the branches.

verses.text: The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
"O son of man! Speak a parable to the house of Israel; and say unto them:
Thus saith the Lord God: A great eagle with long wings, full of feathers, which had divers colors, came unto Lebanon, and took the highest branch of the cedar:
He cropped off the top of his young twigs, and carried it into a land of traffic; he set it in a city of merchants.
He took also of the seed of the land, and planted it in a fruitful field; he placed it by great waters, and set it as a willow tree.

And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him; so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.

There was also another great eagle with large wings and many feathers; and, behold, this vine did bend her roots toward him, and shot forth her branches toward him, that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation.
It was planted in a good soil by great waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine.

Say thou, Thus saith the Lord God: Shall it prosper? Shall he not pull up the roots thereof, and cut off the fruit thereof, that it wither? It shall wither in all the leaves of her spring, even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof.
Yea, behold, being planted, shall it prosper? Shall it not utterly wither, when the east wind toucheth it? It shall wither in the furrows where it grew."

sections.title: The translation of the title "የምሳሌው ትርጓሜ" is "The Translation of the Proverb."

verses.text: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:

"O son of man, dost thou not know what this parable is concerning the house of Israel, which I speak unto them? Thus say unto them: Behold, the king of Babylon hath come unto Jerusalem; he hath taken her kings and her princes, and brought them unto him in Babylon.
And he hath made a covenant with the seed of the kingdom, and hath taken an oath of him; and he hath taken away the mighty of the land.
Thus shall the kingdom be in a state of ruin, and from henceforth it shall not be exalted; but it shall remain in safety by keeping the covenant.

Yet he hath spread his net upon him; he hath given horses and a multitude of people to be sent unto Egypt. Shall it prosper? Shall he that doeth this escape? Shall he break the covenant and be delivered?
"I am alive! He who hath spoken and the one who hath been taken captive, the king who hath broken the covenant, shall surely die in the place where he is, saith the Lord God.
For he shall not be delivered by great power and by a multitude of people in war; for Pharaoh shall not help him.
And by breaking the covenant he hath profaned the sanctuary; behold, I have stretched out my hand upon him; I have done all these things; therefore he shall not escape.
Therefore thus saith the Lord God: I am alive! I have brought upon him the captivity and the covenant which he hath broken upon himself.
And I will spread my net upon him; he shall be taken in my snare; and I will bring him to Babylon; and for the iniquity he hath committed against me, there will I judge him."
And all that are appointed shall fall by the sword; and all that remain shall be scattered as the wind blows; and I, the Lord, as I have spoken, you shall know.

sections.title: A promise given by the Lord God.

verses.text: "Thus saith the Lord God: I have made a dwelling upon the high mountain, and I have set my dwelling upon the summit; I will make one of the peaks a dwelling place; upon the high and great mountain shall I establish it."

"Upon the high mountain in Israel will I establish it; it shall bring forth branches; its fruit shall be abundant; it shall become a great dwelling; and all the birds of the heavens shall find shelter therein; and all that creep upon the ground shall find refuge beneath its branches; the branch shall be spread wide."

"All the trees of the forest, I have made the tall tree low, and the short tree high; I have made the tree that is not flourishing to flourish, and the tree that is withered I have caused to be without blemish; I am the Lord God, and they shall know that I am; I, the Lord God, have spoken; I have also done it."

sections.title: "The soul that sins, it shall die."

verses.text: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፦
“በእስራኤል ልጆች፦ ‘አባቶች ጨርቋ የወይን ፍሬ በሉ፥ የልጆችም ጥርሶች ጠረሱ’ ብላችሁ በመካከላችሁ የምትመስሉት ምሳሌ ምንድን ነው?
እኔ ሕያው ነኝ! እንግዲህ ወዲህ ይህን ምሳሌ በእስራኤል ዘንድ አትመስሉትም፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።
እነሆ ነፍሳት ሁሉ የእኔ ናቸው፤ የአባት ነፍስ የእኔ እንደ ሆነች እንዲሁ የልጅ ነፍስ የእኔ ናት፤ ኀጢአት የምትሠራ ነፍስ እርስዋ ትሞታለች።
“ሰውም ጻድቅ ቢሆን ፍርድንና ቅን ነገርንም ቢያደርግ፤
በተራራም ላይ ባይበላ፥ ዐይኖቹንም ወደ እስራኤል ቤት ጣዖታት ባያነሣ፥ የባልንጀራውንም ሚስት ባያረክስ፥ አደፍም ወዳለባት ሴት ባይቀርብ፤
ሰውንም ባያስጨንቅ፥ ለባለ ዕዳም መያዣውን ቢመልስ፥ ፈጽሞም ባይቀማ፥ ከእንጀራውም ለተራበ ቢሰጥ፥ የተራቈተውንም ከልብሱ ቢያለብስ፤
በአራጣ ባያበድር፥ አትርፎም ባይወስድ፥ እጁንም ከኀጢአት ቢመልስ፥ በሰውና በሰው መካከልም የእውነትን ፍርድ ቢፈርድ፥
በትእዛዜም ቢሄድ፥ እውነትንም ለማድረግ ፍርዴን ቢጠብቅ፥ እርሱ ጻድቅ ነው፤ ፈጽሞ በሕይወት ይኖራል፥” ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።
“እርሱም ቀማኛና ደም አፍሳሽ ልጅን፥ ከዚህም ሁሉ አንዳቸውን የሚያደርገውን ቢወልድ፥
And if he does not walk in the way of his righteous father, even if he eats upon the mountain, and even if he takes his neighbor's wife,
If he oppresses the poor and the needy, if he does not return the pledge, if his eyes are lifted up to the idols, and if he commits abominable acts,
If he commits robbery, and does not turn away, such a man shall not live; he has done all these abominations, therefore he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him.
"Behold, if a son is born, and he does not see the sin of his father, and if he fears, he shall not act as his father has acted,
If he does not eat upon the mountain, and if his eyes do not look toward the idols of the house of Israel, and if he does not take his neighbor's wife;
If he does not oppress a man, and does not take a pledge, and does not commit robbery, if he gives his bread to the hungry and covers the naked with clothing,
If he returns his hand from oppression, and does not take a pledge, if he does what is right and walks in my statutes, he shall surely live; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father.
But his father has surely died in iniquity, and he has oppressed his brother, and has done evil among the people; behold, he shall die in his iniquity.
"But you say, 'Why does the son not bear the iniquity of the father?' When the son has done what is lawful and right, and has kept all my statutes and has done them, he shall surely live.

The soul that sins shall die; the son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, nor shall the father bear the iniquity of the son; the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon himself, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon himself.
"The wicked, if he turns from all his wickedness that he hath done, and keepeth all My statutes, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live; he shall not die."
"None of the transgressions of the wicked shall be mentioned unto him; in his righteousness that he hath done shall he live."
"Yet sayeth the Lord God, 'Shall not the wicked die if he turn from his wickedness, and live?' For it is the way of the wicked that he should return and live."

"But if the righteous turn from his righteousness and commit iniquity, shall he live? All his righteousness that he hath done shall not be mentioned; in his trespass that he hath trespassed, and in his sin that he hath sinned, in them shall he die."
"But ye say, 'The way of the Lord is not equal.' Hear now, O house of Israel: Is not My way equal? Are not your ways unequal?"
"When the righteous turneth from his righteousness and committeth iniquity, he shall die therein; for his iniquity that he hath done shall he die."
"And if the wicked turn from his wickedness, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive."
"All his transgressions that he hath committed shall not be mentioned unto him; in his righteousness that he hath done shall he live."
"Yet the house of Israel saith, 'The way of the Lord is not equal.' O house of Israel, are not My ways equal? Are not your ways unequal?"
"Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord God; repent, and turn yourselves from all your offenses; so sin shall not be your ruin."
የበደላችሁትን በደል ሁሉ ከእናንተ ጣሉ፤ አዲስ ልብና አዲስ መንፈስንም ለእናንተ አድርጉ፤ የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ! ስለ ምን ትሞታላችሁ?
የምዋቹን ሞት አልፈቅድምና፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ ስለዚህ በንስሓ ተመለሱና በሕይወት ኑሩ።

sections.title: The Psalm of Lamentation

verses.text: “አንተም ለእስራኤል አለቃ ይህን ሙሾ አሙሽለት፤
እንዲህም በል፦ እናትህ ምን ነበረች? እንስት አንበሳ ነበረች፤ በአንበሶች መካከል ተጋደመች፤ በደቦል አንበሶችም መካከል ግልገሎችዋን አሳደገች።
ከግልገሎችዋም አንዱን አወጣች፤ እርሱም ደቦል አንበሳ ሆነ፤ ንጥቂያንም ተማረ፤ ሰዎችንም ነጥቆ በላ።
አሕዛብም ስለ እርሱ ሰሙ፤ እርሱም በጕድጓዳቸው ተያዘ፤ በሰንሰለትም አስረው ወደ ግብፅ ምድር ወሰዱት።
እርስዋም ከእርስዋ እንደ ወሰዱት ባየች ጊዜ ኀይልዋ ጠፋ፤ ከግልገሎችዋም ሌላን ወስዳ ደቦል አንበሳ አደረገችው።
እርሱም በአንበሶች መካከል አደገ፤ ደቦል አንበሳም ሆነ፤ ንጥቂያም ተማረ፤ ሰዎችንም ነጥቆ በላ።
ተዘልሎም ይኖራል፤ ከተሞቻቸውንም አጠፋ፤ ሀገራቸውንም አፈረሰ፤ ከግሣቱም ድምፅ የተነሣ ምድርና ሞላዋ ጠፋች።
አሕዛብም በዙሪያው ከየሀገሩ ሁሉ ተሰበሰቡበት፤ መረባቸውንም በእርሱ ላይ ዘረጉ፤ በወጥመዳቸውም ተያዘ።
በሰንሰለትም አስረው በቀፎ ውስጥ አኖሩት፤ ወደ ባቢሎንም ንጉሥ አመጡት፤ ድምፁም በእስራኤል ተራሮች ላይ ከዚያ ወዲያ እንዳይሰማ ወደ ግዞት ቤት አገቡት።
“እናትህ በውኃ አጠገብ እንደ ተተከለች እንደ ወይን ግንድና እንደ ጽጌረዳ ነበረች፤ ከውኃም ብዛት የተነሣ የምታፈራና የምትሰፋ ሆነች።
And from her, the harvest came forth abundantly; she was as a ruler among the rulers; in the midst of the trees, her stature was exalted; and in her branches, her length was seen.

Yet, in the season, she was uprooted; and she was cast down to the ground; the wind that would scatter her, severed her fruits; the mighty ones were broken in her branches, and they withered; and fire consumed them.
Even now, in the wilderness, upon the dry and parched land, she has been sown.

From the chosen branches of her, fire came forth; and her fruits were consumed; and as for the rulers, it shall be as fire, for there is no strength in them. This is a lamentation; it shall be for mourning.

sections.title: The slumber of Israel

verses.text: And it came to pass, in the seventh year, in the fifth month, on the tenth day of the month, that men from the children of Israel, the elders, came to inquire of the Lord; and they sat before me.
And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
"Son of man! Speak unto the elders of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God: Are ye come to inquire of me? As I live, saith the Lord God, I will not be inquired of by you."
Nevertheless, I will bring to remembrance the iniquities of their fathers upon them; son of man! Cause them to know their fathers' iniquities.

And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God: In the day when I chose Israel, and lifted up mine hand unto the seed of the house of Jacob, and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt, I lifted up mine hand unto them, saying, I am the Lord your God; I am not a stranger unto you.

In that day, when I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, and led them into a land that I had espied for them, flowing with milk and honey, the glory of all lands, I lifted up mine hand unto them.
And I said unto them, Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt: I am the Lord your God; I am not a stranger unto you.

But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken unto me: they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt: then I said I would pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.

But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, among whom they were, in whose sight I made myself known unto them, in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt.
"I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness."
When a man acts, I have given him my statutes by which he shall live; I have made known my judgments to him.
As for those who sanctify themselves, let them know that I am the Lord their God; and I have given them my Sabbath as a sign between me and them.

However, I did not lead the house of Israel through the wilderness by my command; they did not follow me; for when a man acts, he shall not disregard my law which gives life; they have profaned my Sabbath. Thus, in this time, I will pour out my wrath upon them in the wilderness.
Yet I made it so that they would not profane my name before the nations, lest they should lift it up above all.

And I raised my hand against them, that they should not enter the land which I had given them, nor the land which I had promised them, that they might not inherit it; thus I lifted my hand against them in the wilderness.
For they have profaned my judgments, and they did not walk in my statutes; they have also profaned my Sabbath, and their hearts went after their idols.
Yet I did not destroy them, as I had not cast them away; in the wilderness, I did not make an end of them; my eyes were upon them.
"As for their children, let them not do this in the wilderness: Do not walk in the customs of your fathers; do not keep their statutes; do not defile yourselves with their idols; do not be unclean."
I am the Lord your God; walk in my statutes; keep my judgments; and do them.
My Sabbaths are holy; and you shall know that I am the Lord your God, as I am holy among you, that there may be a sign between me and you.

But their children have provoked me; they have not kept my judgment, nor have they walked in my statutes; they have profaned my sabbaths; therefore, I will pour out my fury upon them in the wilderness.
Nevertheless, I made it so that my name would not be profaned before them, in the sight of the nations, which are greater than they.
Moreover, I lifted my hand against them, to bring them into the wilderness, and among the nations, I lifted my hand against them in the wilderness.
They have not executed my judgments, and they have despised my statutes, and they have profaned my sabbaths; their eyes were set on the idols of their fathers.
Furthermore, they have given them a judgment that is not good, and a decree by which they shall not live.
And I, even I, have caused them to know that I am the Lord, in order that they might know all that I have done for them, in the time of their coming out.
"Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel, and say to them: 'Thus says the Lord God: "Do not let your fathers provoke me to anger in the same way they did."

And I gave them my hand, and I brought them into the land; I saw all the high places, and every green tree; and there they offered their sacrifices, and there they presented their offerings, and there they made their sweet savor; and there they poured out their drink offerings.
And I said to them, "What is the high place to which you go?" And they called its name Bamah to this day.
Therefore, say to the house of Israel: 'Thus says the Lord God: "You have defiled yourselves by the iniquities of your fathers; you have committed treachery; you have followed their abominations."

"Your sacrifices, when you offered them, and your children, when you caused them to pass through the fire, even unto this day, have I not commanded you, O house of Israel? I am alive! I will not answer you," saith the Lord God.
"And as for you: we shall be as the nations and as the families of the earth; we shall regard wood and stone, for the thought that proceeds from your hearts shall not be fulfilled."

sections.title: The wrath and mercy of the Lord.

verses.text: "I am the living God! With a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out, I will speak to you," says the Lord God.
"I will bring you out from among the nations; I will gather you from all the countries where you have been scattered, with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out."
"And I will bring you into the wilderness of the nations, and there I will plead with you face to face."
"Just as I pleaded with your fathers in the land of Egypt, so will I plead with you," says the Lord God.
"I will cause you to pass under the rod; I will bring you into the bond of the covenant."

"And I will purge out from among you the rebels and those who transgress against me; I will bring them out of the land where they sojourn, but they shall not enter the land of Israel; and you shall know that I am the Lord."

"O house of Israel, thus says the Lord God: Cast away from you all your offenses, and make yourselves a new heart and a new spirit. Why will you die, O house of Israel? For I take no pleasure in the death of anyone, declares the Lord God. Repent and live!"

"On my holy mountain, the high mountain of Israel, says the Lord God, there the whole house of Israel, all of them, will serve me in the land; there I will accept them, and there I will require your offerings and the firstfruits of your sacrifices."
"When I bring you out from the nations and gather you from the countries where you have been scattered, I will accept you as a pleasing aroma; and I will show you favor in the sight of the nations."
"And I will give you the land of your fathers, and you shall possess it; and you shall know that I am the Lord."
And thus, you shall remember all your ways and your works wherein you have been blessed; and before you, you shall not be ashamed for all your iniquities which you have committed.
O house of Israel! As your ways are evil and your works are abominable, so shall you call upon Me in the time of your labor; and I, the Lord God, shall be known unto you, says the Lord God.
And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying this;
"O son of man! Set your face toward Teman; and look toward the south; and prophesy against the forest of the south.

And to the forest of the south, say this: Hear the word of the Lord; thus says the Lord God: Behold, I will kindle a fire in you; and it shall devour every green tree in you, and every dry tree; the flaming fire shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein.
I, the Lord, have kindled it; it shall not be quenched.
And I said: "O Lord God, let it not be so; but they shall say: Is this not the parable that we have spoken?"

sections.title: The sword of the Lord shall be upon Babylon.

verses.text: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፦
“የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! ስለዚህ ትንቢት ተናገር፤ ፊትህን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም አቅና፤ ወደ መቅደሶችም ተመልከት፤ በእስራኤልም ምድር ላይ ትንቢት ተናገር።
ለእስራኤልም ምድር እንዲህ በል፦ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ እነሆ በአንቺ ላይ ነኝ፤ ሰይፌንም ከሰገባው እመዝዘዋለሁ፤ ጻድቁንና ኃጥኡን ከአንቺ ዘንድ አጠፋለሁ።
እኔም ጻድቁንና ኃጥኡን ከአንቺ ዘንድ ስለማጠፋ፥ ስለዚህ ሰይፌ ከደቡብ ጀምሮ እስከ ሰሜን ድረስ በአለ በሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ ላይ ከሰገባው ይመዘዛል።
ሥጋ ለባሹም ሁሉ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ሰይፌን ከሰገባው እንደ መዘዝሁ ያውቃል፤ እርሱም ደግሞ አይመለስም።
ስለዚህ አንተ የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! ወገብህን በማጕበጥ አልቅስ፤ በፊታቸውም ምርር ብለህ አልቅስ።
እነርሱም፦ ስለ ምን ታለቅሳለህ? ቢሉህ አንተ እንዲህ በላቸው፦ ስለሚመጣው ወሬ ነው፤ ልብም ሁሉ ይቀልጣል፤ እጆችም ሁሉ ይዝላሉ፤ ሥጋና መንፈስ ሁሉ ይደክማል፤ ከጕልበትም እዥ ይፈስሳል፤ እነሆ ይመጣል፤ ይፈጸማልም፥” ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።
የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፦
“የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል ብለህ ትንቢት ተናገር፤ ሰይፍ ሰይፍ የተሳለች፥ የተሰነገለችም ሁኚ።
ወግተሽ ትገድሊ ዘንድ፥ ታብረቀርቂም ዘንድ ተሳዪ፤ ትገድሊም ዘንድ፥ ዕንጨቱንም ሁሉ ትጥዪ ዘንድ ጨክኚ፤
And it was given into the hand of the warrior; for the sword was to be placed in the hand of the slayer, and she was prepared.
O son of man! For it is upon my people, and it is upon all the leaders of Israel; cry out, and wail; for they have been given to the sword along with my people; therefore, set your hand to writing.
Truly, it has come to pass; what has become of the people who have been slain? There is none, says the Lord God.
Therefore, you, O son of man! Prophesy; and let your hand be upon your hand; for the slain shall fall by the sword three times; behold, it is a great slaughtering sword; it has made them desolate.
That their hearts may melt, and their spirits may be crushed, I will place the sword that brings death upon all their gates; woe! For it has been sharpened to slay; it has been prepared to devour.
Go forth before you to the right or to the left.
I also will set my hand upon my hand; I will send my sword forth; for I, the Lord God, have spoken.
And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying:
"You also, O son of man! Make two ways for the sword of Babylon to come; both shall come forth out of one land; and make a sign; set it at the head of the way to the city."
The sword against the children of Ammon, and against Rabbah, and against Judah, and against Jerusalem; make a way in the midst of her.
The king of Babylon shall be brought low, and he shall be cast down to the ground; his idols shall be sought, and he shall stand upon his own head in two ways.

To make the destruction of the fortress, and to open his mouth with a cry, and to raise his voice in the streets, to make the destruction of the fortress upon the gates, and to cause the earth to tremble, and to work in the evening, the fortress of Jerusalem was within his right hand.
He shall bring low the fortress before them; and he shall remember their iniquities and shall cast them down to the pit.

“Therefore thus saith the Lord God: Because of your iniquities, and because of your transgressions, and because your iniquities have been seen in all your works, and because you have been remembered, you shall be taken by Him.”
You also, your day and the time of your iniquity has come upon you, O wicked sinner, leader of Israel!
The Lord God saith: Cast away the abomination; let the wicked be removed; this shall not be so; lift up the fallen; and bring down the exalted.
Woe, woe, woe! I shall bring judgment until it comes; this shall not be so; for him I shall give.

“You, O son of man! Thus saith the Lord God concerning the children of Ammon and concerning their reproach: Prophesy and say, A sword, a sword is drawn to slay; it is sharpened and polished to make a slaughter.”
Upon the slain sinners shall your eyes rest, when they see a vain vision, and when they speak to you with false words; their iniquities have come upon them, and their time has come.
And return to the place of your captivity; do not enter the place of your birth; for I shall judge you in the land of your nativity.
"I will unleash my wrath upon thee; and in my time, I will kindle a fire against thee; and I will deliver my hand to those who know destruction, to the wicked."
"Thou shalt be a fuel for the fire; thy blood shall be poured out upon the ground; and do not think otherwise; for I, the Lord God, have spoken."

sections.title: The people of Jerusalem have sinned.

verses.text: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying:
"O son of man! Dost thou not tremble at the blood that is shed in the city? Remember all her abominations."
Thus saith the Lord God: "Thy time is come, O city, wherein thou dost shed blood, that thou mayest be remembered for thy wickedness."

"In the blood that thou hast shed, thou hast become guilty; and in the idols that thou hast made, thou hast been defiled; thou hast offered thy days, and thy times have been brought to an end; therefore, I have made thee a reproach unto the nations, and a mocking unto all countries."
"Thou art named the one who is guilty, and thy sin is full! Those who come near unto thee and those who are far off shall be astonished at thee."
"Behold, the princes of the house of Israel, each one according to his time, have shed blood in thee."
"In thee have they slain father and mother; in the midst of thee have they committed oppression; in thee have they wronged the poor and the needy."
"My sanctuaries have they profaned; my sabbaths have they greatly violated."
"In thee have they shed blood, and the people were in thee; in thee have they spoken upon the mountains; in the midst of thee have they committed abominations."
"In thee have they revealed the iniquities of their fathers; in thee have they exposed the abominations that are within."
And a man shall be joined to his wife; and a father shall commit sin against his son by taking his son's wife; and a brother shall defile his sister, the daughter of his father.

Within you, they shall shed blood, and they shall accept the judgment; and within you, they shall bring forth gain and profit; your abominations and your sins shall be executed; and they shall say unto me, "O Lord God."
"Therefore, behold, I have poured out my wrath upon you for the deeds you have done, and I have poured out my fury upon the blood that was in your midst."
Shall I not be grieved by your actions? Or shall your hands not be weakened? I, the Lord God, have spoken; I will act.
And I will scatter you among the nations; and in the countries, I will disperse you; and your filthiness shall be removed from you.
Before the nations, I will be avenged upon you; and they shall know that I am the Lord God.
And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying:
"O son of man! The house of Israel is become dross; they are all brass and tin and iron and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are even the dross of silver."
Therefore, saith the Lord God, "All of you have become dross; behold, I will gather you in Jerusalem."

To cause them to be melted, I will bring forth fire upon them, and they shall be consumed; as silver and brass and tin and iron and lead are melted in the fire, so shall I melt them in my wrath and in my fury; and I will gather them and bring them to the city.
"I will kindle the fire of My wrath against you; in the midst of you, you shall be consumed."
"As silver is refined in the furnace, so shall you be refined within it; and I, the Lord, will know that I have purified you."

sections.title: The leaders of Israel in sin.

verses.text: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying thus:
"O son of man! Thou art a land that is not cleansed, and a land that is not rained upon in the day of indignation."

The prophets that are in the midst of her are like roaring lions; they shall tear in pieces, they shall devour, they shall break in pieces, and they shall consume the flesh; they shall multiply their widows in the midst of her.

And her priests have violated my law, and have profaned mine holy things; they have put no difference between the holy and the profane, neither have they showed difference between the unclean and the clean; and they have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.
Her princes in the midst of her are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.
And her prophets have daubed them with untempered morter, seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord God, when the Lord hath not spoken.
The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery, and have vexed the poor and needy; yea, they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully.
I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it; but I found none.
Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath; their own way have I recompensed upon their heads, saith the Lord God."

sections.title: Two sisters are joined together.

verses.text: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፦
“የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ የአንዲት እናት ልጆች የሆኑ ሁለት ሴቶች ነበሩ።
በግብፅ ሀገር አመነዘሩ፤ በኮረዳነታቸው ሳሉ አመነዘሩ፤ በዚያም ጡቶቻቸው ወደቁ፤ በዚያም ድንግልናቸውን አጡ።
ስማቸውም የታላቂቱ ሐላ የታናሽ እኅቷም ሐሊባ ነበረ፤ እኔም አገባኋቸው፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችንም ወለዱ። ስማቸውም ሐላ ሰማርያ ናት፤ ሐሊባ ደግሞ ኢየሩሳሌም ናት።
“ሐላም አመነዘረችብኝ፤ ወዳጆችዋንም የሚቀርቡአትን አሦራውያንን በፍቅር ተከተለቻቸው።
እነርሱም ሰማያዊ ሐር የለበሱ መሳፍንትና መኳንንት፥ መልከ መልካሞች ጐበዛዝት፥ በፈረስ ላይ የሚቀመጡ የተመረጡ ፈረሰኞች ነበሩ።
ዝሙቷንም ከተመረጡ ከአሦር ሰዎች ሁሉ ጋር አደረገች፤ በፍቅር በተከተለቻቸውም ጣዖቶቻቸው ሁሉ ረከሰች።
በግብፅም የነበረውን ዝሙቷን አልተወችም፤ በዚያም በኮረዳነቷ ጊዜ ከእርስዋ ጋር ተኝተው ነበር፤ የድንግልናዋንም ጡቶች ዳብሰው ነበር፤ ዝንየታቸውንም አፍስሰውባት ነበር።
ስለዚህ በፍቅር በተከተለቻቸው በወዳጆችዋ በአሦራውያን እጆች አሳልፌ ሰጠኋት።
እነርሱም ኀፍረተ ሥጋዋን ገለጡ፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችዋንም ማርከው ወሰዱ፤ እርስዋንም በሰይፍ ገደሉ፤ በእርስዋና በሴቶች ልጆችዋ ላይ በቀልን ስላደረጉባቸው በሴቶች መካከል መተረቻ ሆነች።
"And her sister saw this; yet she was more grieved by following her in love than by her own widowhood, for her widowhood was greater than that of her sister."
"They adorned themselves with the garments of the noble and the garments of the horsemen, those who sit upon horses; they were all beautiful in appearance, and the Assyrians followed them in love."
"As I beheld, they both walked in one way."
"The widow also was made to suffer; and I saw the image of the men of the Assyrians who were adorned upon the wall."

"I saw the likeness of the Assyrians adorned in black; they were washed in their own blood; they were marked with a scar upon themselves; and their faces were threefold; all of them resembled the men of Babylon who dwell in their own land."
"And their eyes looked towards them; and she sent messengers to them upon the land of the Chaldeans."

"And the children of Babylon came unto her and lay with her in her youth; and they were joined with her in their widowhood; and she was made to suffer with them; and her soul was separated from them."
"Her widowhood was made manifest; and her flesh was laid bare; and my soul was separated from her sister as my soul was separated from her."
"But consider the time of your youth which you have spent in the land of Egypt; remember your widowhood and increase it."
"Their bodies were like the bodies of horses; and their seed was like the seed of horses; these children of the Assyrians were followed in love."
"Your breast, in the time of your distress, has thought upon the sin of your youth, when you were in the land of Egypt."
