"Therefore, O harlot! Thus saith the Lord God, 'I will raise up your lovers, from whom your soul is separated, and I will bring them against you from every side.'"

"And they are the children of Babylon, all the Chaldeans, the Peccud, the Shuh, the Koa, and all the Assyrians with them, the goodly young men, the captains and the rulers, all of them mounted upon horses."

"All those who remember their names shall come against you with the sword and with the spear; and they shall surround you with their heads uncovered, and I will bring judgment upon them; they shall be judged according to their judgments."

"I will make your beauty a desolation; they shall make you desolate; your nostrils and your ears shall be cut off from you; and what remains of you shall fall by the sword; your sons and daughters shall be taken captive; and the fire shall consume what remains of you."
"Your garments shall be stripped off you; and they shall take away your glorious crown."
"Your nakedness, which you have brought forth from the land of Egypt, I will cause to be remembered no more; your eyes shall not look upon them again; and Egypt shall not be remembered anymore."
"Therefore, thus saith the Lord God: Behold, I will deliver you into the hand of those whom you hate, and your soul shall be delivered into the hand of those who are separated from you."
"They shall deal harshly with you; they shall take away all that you have labored for; they shall lay bare your nakedness and your shame; your nakedness and your shame shall be revealed."
"Because you have been in league with the people, and because of their wickedness, this shall be done unto you."
I have gone in the way of thy sister; therefore, I will give thee her cup in thy hand.
Thus saith the Lord God: "Thou shalt drink of the cup of thy sister, the cup of deep sorrow and abundance; thou shalt be a vessel of much pouring out among those who drink deeply."
In thy sister's cup, in the cup of Samaria, in the cup of the stone and of destruction, in the cup of the wine and of the fall, thou shalt be filled.
Thou shalt drink it, thou shalt drain it; I will pour out thy feasts and thy solemn assemblies; for I have spoken, saith the Lord God.
Therefore, thus saith the Lord God: "Thou art become a reproach, and thy sins and iniquities have laid hold upon thee."
And the Lord said unto me, "O son of man! They have made themselves a snare; they have laid hold of their iniquities."
For they have shed blood, and their hands are full of it; they have committed abominations, and they have offered their children in fire unto their idols.
This also have they done unto me; on that day they have profaned my sanctuary; they have desecrated my holy place.
And their children they have offered unto their idols in the time of their calamity; on that day they entered into my sanctuary, and behold, they have done thus in my house.
And from a far country they sent messengers unto the people; and when they arrived, they shall be purified; their eyes shall be opened; they shall be astonished.
በክብር አልጋ ላይ ይቀመጣሉ፤ በፊት ለፊታቸውም ማዕድ ተዘጋጅታ ነበር፤ በዕጣኔና በዘይቴም ደስ ይላቸዋል።
የበገናውን አውታር ድምፅ ይቃኛሉ፤ ከብዙ ሰዎችም ጉባኤ ጋር ሰካራሞቹ ከምድረ በዳ መጡ፤ በእጃቸው አንባር፥ በራሳቸውም የተዋበ አክሊል አደረጉ።
እኔም፦ ‘አሁን ከእርስዋ ጋር ያመነዝራሉ፤ እርስዋም ከእነርሱ ጋር ታመነዝራለች፤’ አልሁ።
ወደ ጋለሞታ እንደሚገቡም ወደ እርስዋ ገቡ፤ እንዲሁ ይሰስኑ ዘንድ ወደ ሐላና ወደ ሐሊባ ገቡ።
ሴቶቹ አመንዝሮች ናቸውና፥ በእጃቸውም ደም አለና ጻድቃን ሰዎች በአመንዝሮቹና በደም አፍሳሾቹ ሴቶች ላይ በሚፈረደው ፍርድ ይፈርዱባቸዋል።”
ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፥ “ጉባኤን አመጣባቸዋለሁ፤ ለመበተንና ለመበዝበዝም አሳልፌ እሰጣቸዋለሁ።
ጉባኤውም በድንጋይ ይወግሩአቸዋል፤ በሰይፋቸውም ይቈርጡአቸዋል፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውንም ይገድላሉ፤ ቤቶቻቸውንም በእሳት ያቃጥላሉ።
ሴቶችም ሁሉ እንደ ኀጢአታችሁ እንዳይሠሩ ይማሩ ዘንድ ሴሰኝነትን ከምድር ላይ አጠፋለሁ።
እንግዲህ በደላችሁ በላያችሁ ላይ ይመለሳል፤ እናንተም የጣዖቶቻችሁን ኀጢአት ትሸከማላችሁ፤ እኔም ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።”

sections.title: The parable of the fig tree.

verses.text: በዘጠነኛው ዓመት በዐሥረኛው ወር ከወሩም በዐሥረኛው ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፦
“የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! የዚህን ቀን፥ የዛሬን ቀን ስም ጻፍ፤ በዚህ ቀን የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይመጣልና።
ለዐመፀኛውም ቤት ምሳሌን ተናገር እንዲህም በላቸው፦ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ ጣድ፥ ድስቲቱን ጣድ፥ ውኃም ጨምርባት።
ቍራጭዋንም፥ መልካሙን ቍራጭ ሁሉ፥ ጭኑንና ወርቹን በእርስዋ ውስጥ ጨምር፤ የተመረጡትንም አጥንቶች ሙላባት።
ከመንጋው የተመረጠውን ውሰድ፤ አጥንቶቹም እንዲበስሉ በበታችዋ እሳት አንድድ፤ አፍላው፤ በእጅጉ ይፍላ፤ አጥንቶቹም በውስጥዋ ይቀቀሉ።
“ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ ዝገቷ ላለባት፥ ዝገቷም ከእርስዋ ላልወጣ ድስት፥ ለደም ከተማ ወዮላት! ቍራጭ ቍራጩን አውጣ፤ ዕጣ አልወደቀባትም።
ደምዋም በመካከልዋ አለ። በተራቈተ ድንጋይ ላይ አደረገችው እንጂ በአፈር ይከደን ዘንድ በመሬት ላይ አላፈሰሰችውም።
መዓቴን አወጣ ዘንድ፥ በቀሌንም እበቀል ዘንድ፥ ደምዋ እንዳይከደን በተራቈተ ድንጋይ ላይ አደረግሁ።
ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ ለደም ከተማ ወዮላት! እኔ ደግሞ ማገዶዋን ታላቅ አደርገዋለሁ።
ደሟ እስኪያልቅ ድረስ ሥጋዋ ያርር ዘንድ፥ አጥንቶችዋም ይቀጠቀጡ ዘንድ፤ እንጨቱን አበዛለሁ፤ እሳቱንም አነድዳለሁ፥
"I will dwell upon her until she is in anguish and until she is broken; her wickedness shall be in the midst of her, as a stench it shall rise; her filth shall be consumed."
"She has become desolate in vain; yet, much of her filth shall not depart from her."
"Your wickedness is great; I have delivered you; yet you shall not be delivered, for until your time is fulfilled, you shall not be freed from your wickedness."

"I, the Lord God, have spoken; I will come; I will also act; I will not turn away; I will not relent; I will not cease; according to your ways and according to your deeds, I will judge you, says the Lord God. Therefore, as you have shed man's blood, I will judge you; and as for your iniquity, I will cause it to cease; your name shall be forgotten, and much sorrow shall you endure."

sections.title: The Death of the Prophet's Wife

verses.text: The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
"O son of man! Behold, I shall take away the eye of your sight by the sword; do not weep, do not mourn, and do not let your tears flow."

"With a sigh, you shall sigh; however, you shall not mourn for the dead; you shall bind your turban upon your head, and put your shoes on your feet; you shall not cover your lips, nor shall you eat the bread of men."
And I spoke to the people in the morning; and in the evening my wife died; and in the morning I did as I was commanded.
And the people said to me, "What you are doing, what does it mean to us?"
And I answered them, "The word of the Lord came to me, saying:

'Speak to the house of Israel, and say to them: Thus says the Lord God: Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the pride of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and the longing of your soul; and your sons and your daughters whom you have left shall fall by the sword.'"
"And I will do to you as I have done; you shall not mourn, nor shall you weep; nor shall you eat the bread of men."

"Your turban shall be upon your heads, and your shoes shall be on your feet; do not mourn, nor let your tears flow; for your iniquities shall cause you to stumble, and all of you shall be in despair."
"Ezekiel shall be a sign to you; as he has done, so shall you do; and when this comes, you shall know that I am the Lord God."
"O son of man! Their strength, their joy in which they have trusted, their eyes that are uplifted, their souls' desires, on the day I have taken their children away from them,
On that day, this word shall come to your ears, and it shall come unto you.
On that day, your mouth shall be opened to speak; and you shall speak; and from then on, you shall not be dumb; and a sign shall be unto you; and they shall know that I am the Lord."

sections.title: The Prophecy Concerning Ammon

verses.text: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፦
“የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! ፊትህን ወደ አሞን ልጆች አቅንተህ ትንቢት ተናገርባቸው።
ለአሞንም ልጆች እንዲህ በል፦ የጌታን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፤ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ መቅደሴ በረከሰ ጊዜ የእስራኤልም ምድር ባድማ በሆነች ጊዜ፥ የይሁዳም ቤት በተማረኩ ጊዜ ስለ እነርሱ ደስ ብሎሃልና፤
ስለዚህ እነሆ ርስት አድርጌ ለምሥራቅ ልጆች አሳልፌ እሰጥሃለሁ፤ እነርሱም ማደሪያዎቻቸውን በአንተ ዘንድ ይሠራሉ፤ ድንኳኖቻቸውንም በአንተ ውስጥ ይተክላሉ፤ ፍሬህን ይበላሉ፤ ወተትህንም ይጠጣሉ።
የአሞንን ከተማ ለግመሎች ማሰማሪያ፥ የአሞንንም ልጆች ለመንጋ መመሰጊያ አደርጋለሁ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።
ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና፦ በእጆችህ አጨብጭበሃልና፥ በእግሮችህም አሸብሽበሃልና፥ ሰውነትህም በእስራኤል ምድር ላይ ደስ ብሎአታልና፤
ስለዚህ እነሆ እጄን ዘርግቼብሃለሁ፤ ለአሕዛብም አስበዘብዝሃለሁ፤ ከአሕዛብም ለይች እቈርጥሃለሁ፤ ከሀገሮችም እደመስስሃለሁ፤ አጠፋሃለሁም፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃለህ።”

sections.title: The Prophecy Concerning Moab

verses.text: The Lord God saith, "Moab and Seir: Behold, the house of Judah hath declared itself as one of all the nations."
Therefore, behold, I shall bring upon Moab a calamity from its cities, from its border, and from the cities of the plain, from Beth Jeshimoth, from Baal Meon, and from Kiriathaim.
The children of Ammon shall no longer be remembered among the nations; I shall give the children of Ammon as an inheritance to the children of the east.
And upon Moab, I shall pour out My wrath; and they shall know that I am the Lord God."

sections.title: The prophecy concerning Edom.

verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God: "Edom hath dealt treacherously against Judah; and hath laid waste upon it, and hath been filled with deceit."
Therefore, the Lord God saith: "I will stretch out My hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; I will make it desolate; and they that are of Teman and Dedan shall fall by the sword."
"I will lay waste Edom among My people Israel; as the measure of My wrath and as the measure of My vengeance shall they do unto Edom; they shall know My vengeance," saith the Lord God.

sections.title: The prophecy concerning Philistia.

verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God, "The Philistines have dealt treacherously, and they have laid waste to My people; and Israel shall be forsaken forever, for their souls shall rejoice."
Therefore, the Lord God saith, "Behold, I will stretch out My hand against the Philistines; I will cut off the remnant of the coastlands."
In the day of My vengeance, I will bring forth great calamity upon them; and when I shall have made an end of them, they shall know that I am the Lord God."

sections.title: The prophecy concerning Tyre.

verses.text: And it came to pass in the year of the first month of the tenth year, on the first day of the month, that the word of the Lord came unto me, saying:
"Son of man, concerning Tyre: Howl, O ye ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Cyprus it is revealed to them."
Therefore thus saith the Lord God: "Tyre, behold, I am against thee; and I will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth his waves to come up."
They shall destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her like the top of a rock.
It shall be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea; for I have spoken it, saith the Lord God: and it shall become a spoil to the nations.
And her daughters which are in the field shall be slain with the sword; and they shall know that I am the Lord.

"For thus saith the Lord God: Behold, I will bring upon Tyre from the north Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, a king of kings, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and companies, and much people."
He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field; and he shall make a fort against thee, and cast a mount against thee, and lift up the buckler against thee.
And he shall set engines of war against thy walls, and with his axes he shall break down thy towers.

By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee: thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wheels, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into thy gates, as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach.
The horses shall trample your streets; your warriors shall fall by the sword; your mighty men shall be cast down upon the earth.

Your silver shall be plundered; your merchandise shall be burned; your strongholds shall be laid waste; your beloved houses shall be destroyed; your wood and your stone, your land shall be cast into the depths of the sea.
I shall silence the multitude of your singers; the sound of your harp shall no longer be heard.
I shall make you like a shattered stone; your wall shall be a place of refuge; from now on, you shall not be built again; for I, the Lord, have spoken, thus says the Lord.
"Concerning Tyre, the Lord God says this: In the time of your downfall, when your cries arise from the midst of you, will not the isles tremble?

All the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones; they shall lay aside their robes; they shall strip off their garments of fine linen; and upon the earth they shall sit upon the ground and tremble; they shall be afraid for you.

Upon you shall come a shroud; and they shall say: "You who were situated by the sea, you who were in the depths of the sea, all who dwell around you shall be terrified, O city of renown! How you have perished!"
Now in your day of ruin, the isles shall be afraid; and those who are in the sea shall tremble at your going forth.
"Thus says the Lord God: When I made you a desolate city like the cities that are not inhabited, when I brought forth the deep upon you, many waters covered you.

I shall bring you down with those who descend to the pit, to the people of old; and in the land of the living, you shall not dwell, but with those who go down to the abyss, I shall make you dwell beneath the earth.
"I shall deliver you unto death; from henceforth you shall not dwell; they shall seek you, but for eternity shall they not find you," saith the Lord God.

sections.title: Concerning the oracle against Tyre.

verses.text: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፦
“አንተ የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! ስለ ጢሮስ ሙሾ አድርግ።
በባሕር መግቢያ የምትኖር፥ በብዙም ደሴቶች ላይ ከሚኖሩ አሕዛብ ጋር ንግድን የምታደርግ ጢሮስን እንዲህ በላት፦ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ ጢሮስ ሆይ! አንቺ፦ በውበት ፍጹም ነኝ ብለሻል።
ዳርቻሽ በባሕር ውስጥ ነው፤ ልጆችሽም ውበትሽን ፈጽመዋል።
ሳንቃዎችሽን ሁሉ ከሳኔር ጥድ ሠርተዋል፤ ምሰሶዎችሽንም ይሠሩልሽ ዘንድ ከሊባኖስ ዝግባን ወስደዋል።
ከባሳን ኮምቦል መቅዘፊያሽን ሠርተዋል፤ መቅደስሽንም በዝኆን ጥርስ ሠሩ፤ ከኪቲም ደሴቶች ዛፍም ቤቶችሽን ሠርተዋል።
ዓላማ እንዲሆንልሽ ሸራሽ ከግብፅ በፍታና ከወርቀ ዘቦ ተሠርቶአል፤ መደረቢያሽም ከኤሊሳ ደሴቶች ሰማያዊና ቀይ ሐር ተሠርቶአል።
አለቆችሽ በሲዶና ይኖሩ ነበር፤ የአራድ ሰዎችም ቀዛፊዎችሽ ነበሩ፤ ጢሮስ ሆይ! ጥበበኞችሽ በአንቺ ዘንድ ነበሩ፤ የመርከቦችሽም መሪዎች ነበሩ።
በአንቺ ውስጥ የነበሩ የጌባል ሽማግሌዎችና ጥበበኞችዋ ስብራትሽን ይጠግኑ ነበር፤ ከአንቺም ጋር ይነግዱ ዘንድ የባሕር መርከቦች ሁሉና መርከበኞቻቸው በመካከልሽ ነበሩ።
ፋርስና ሉድ፥ ሊብያም በሠራዊትሽ ውስጥ ሰልፈኞችሽ ነበሩ፤ ጋሻና ራስ ቍርም በአንቺ ውስጥ ያንጠለጥሉ ነበር፤ እነርሱም ክብርሽን ሰጡ።
The children of Arad and your soldiers were stationed around your walls; the Gammadim were also within your towers; they did not shake their weapons around your walls; your beauty has been perfected.
"From all your strength, the merchants of Tarshish were present; they brought your market silver, gold, and bronze, and they made trade with coral and fine linen."
Your merchants were from Javan and Tubal; they made trade with the souls of men and with the vessels of brass.
Those who were from the house of Tergama brought horses and horsemen, and they brought them to your market.
The children of Rhodam were your merchants; many were the men of desire who brought you the finest of teeth; and those who came thereafter gave you their price.

The men of Syria were your merchants, who came from the abundance of your wealth; they traded with you, and with many people they conversed; they brought you white wool and black, red wool and gold-colored wool, and they brought you the fine linen called "the fine wool of Tarshish"; your market was filled with rich and fine goods.
Judah and Israel were your merchants; they traded with you in wheat; they brought you fine flour and barley, oil and the best honey, and they gave you their goods in abundance.
From the abundance of your work and from all your splendid wealth, the men of Damascus were your merchants; they brought you wine from Helbon, and they traded with you in white sheep.
Dan and Javan; they brought you the wrought iron and the bronze from Ozel, and they brought you the precious things.
Dedan was your merchant in the choice animals and in their saddles; your merchant was clothed in glorious apparel.
ዓረብና የቄዳር አለቆች ሁሉ የእጅሽ ነጋዴዎች ነበሩ፤ በግመሎችና በአውራ በጎች፥ በፍየሎችም በእነዚህ ከአንቺ ጋር ይነግዱ ነበር።
የሳባና የራዕማ ነጋዴዎች እነዚህ ነጋዴዎችሽ ነበሩ፤ ንግድሽን በጥሩ ሽቱና በከበረ ድንጋይ ሁሉ፥ በወርቅም አደረጉ።
የካራንና የካኔ፥ የኤደንም ሰዎች ነጋዴዎችሽ ነበሩ፤ አሦርና ኪልማድም ነጋዴዎችሽ ነበሩ።
እነዚህ በአማረ ልብስ፥ በሰማያዊ ካባ፥ በወርቀ ዘቦም፥ በዝግባ በተሠራች፥ በገመድም በታሰረች፥ በግምጃም በተሞላች ሣጥን በገበያሽ ይነግዱ ነበር።
የተርሴስ መርከቦች ሸቀጥሽን የሚሸከሙ ነበሩ፤ አንቺም ተሞልተሽ ነበር፤ በባሕርም ውስጥ እጅግ ከበርሽ።
“ቀዛፊዎችሽ ወደ ትልቁ ውኃ አመጡሽ፤ የምሥራቅ ነፋስ በባሕር ውስጥ ሰበረሽ።
ኀይልሽና ዋጋሽ፥ ንግድሽም፥ መርከበኞችሽም፥ መርከብ መሪዎችሽም፥ ሰባራሽን የሚጠግኑ ነጋዴዎችሽም፥ በአንቺም ዘንድ ያሉ ሰልፈኞችሽ ሁሉ በውስጥሽ ከአሉት ጉባኤ ሁሉ ጋር በወደቅሽበት ቀን በባሕር ውስጥ ይጠፋሉ።
ከጩኸትሽ የተነሣ የመርከብሽ መሪዎች ፍርሀትን ፈሩ።
ቀዛፊዎችም ሁሉ፥ በመርከብ የተጫኑትም መርከብ መሪዎችም ሁሉ ከመርከቦቻቸው ይወርዳሉ፤ በየብስም ላይ ይቆማሉ፤
ድምፃቸውንም በአንቺ ላይ ያሰማሉ፤ ምርር ብለውም ይጮኻሉ፤ በራሳቸውም ላይ ትቢያ ይነሰንሳሉ፤ አመድም ያነጥፋሉ።
Concerning thee, they shall cast away their own crown; they shall adorn themselves with mourning; and in their souls, they shall lament bitterly for thee.
And their children shall mourn for thee; they shall say, "Who was like thee, cast down in the midst of the sea, as Tyre was?"
How much value didst thou possess in the sea? In thy splendor, thou didst surround many nations; and all the princes of the earth made themselves a covenant with thee, for thou art unique among them.
But now, thou art cast down into the depths of the sea; all who were one with thee have fallen in the midst of thee. Thy companions shall all perish;
All who dwell in the isles shall be astonished at thee; their kings are sore afraid, and their faces are pale with fear.
The merchants of the nations shall hiss at thee; thou shalt be brought to an end; from this time forth, even unto eternity, thou shalt not be.

sections.title: The prophecy concerning King Tyre.

verses.text: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying thus:

"O son of man! Say unto the prince of Tyre, Thus saith the Lord God: Thy heart is lifted up, and thou hast said, I am a god, I sit in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; yet thou art a man, and not God, though thou set thy heart as the heart of God."
"Art thou wiser than Daniel? There is no secret that they can hide from thee."
"By thy wisdom and by thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures."
"By thy great wisdom and by thy traffic hast thou increased thy riches; and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches."
"Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God,"
"Behold, therefore I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations; and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom, and they shall defile thy brightness."
"They shall bring thee down to the pit, and thou shalt die the deaths of them that are slain in the midst of the seas."
"Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee, I am God? But thou shalt be a man, and no god, in the hand of him that slayeth thee."
"Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord God."
የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፦
“የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! በጢሮስ ንጉሥ ላይ ሙሾ አሙሽበት፤ እንዲህም በለው፦ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ ጥበብን የተሞላህ፥ ውበትህም የተፈጸመ መደምደሚያ አንተ ነህ።
በእግዚአብሔር ገነት በዔድን ነበርህ፤ የከበረ ዕንቍስ ሁሉ፥ ሰርድዮን፥ ቶጳዝዮን፥ አልማዝ፥ ቢረሌ፥ መረግድ፥ ኢያሰጲድ፥ ሰንፔር፥ በሉር፥ የሚያብረቀርቅ ዕንቍ፥ ወርቅም ልብስህ ነበረ፤ የከበሮህና የእንቢልታህ ሥራ በአንተ ዘንድ ነበረ፤ በተፈጠርህበትም ቀን ተዘጋጅተው ነበር።
አንተ ልትጋርድ የተቀባህ ኪሩብ ነበርህ፤ በተቀደሰው በእግዚአብሔር ተራራ ላይ አኖርሁህ፤ በእሳት ድንጋዮች መካከል ተመላለስህ።
ከተፈጠርህበት ቀን ጀምረህ በደል እስከሚገኝብህ ድረስ በመንገድህ ፍጹም ነበርህ።
በንግድህም ብዛት ግፍ በውስጥህ ተሞላ፤ ኀጢአትንም ሠራህ፤ ስለዚህ እንደ ርኩስ ነገር ከእግዚአብሔር ተራራ ጣልሁህ፤ የምትጋርድ ኪሩብ ሆይ! ከእሳት ድንጋዮች መካከል አጠፋሁህ።
በውበትህ ምክንያት ልብህ ኰርቶአል፤ ከክብርህ የተነሣ ጥበብህን አረከስህ፤ በምድር ላይ ጣልሁህ፤ ያዩህም፥ ይዘብቱብህም ዘንድ በነገሥታት ፊት አሳልፌ ሰጠሁህ።
በበደልህ ብዛት፥ በንግድህም ኀጢአት መቅደስህን አረከስህ፤ ስለዚህ እሳትን ከውስጥህ አውጥቻለሁ፤ እርስዋም በልታሃለች፤ በሚያዩህም ሁሉ ፊት በምድር ላይ አመድ አድርጌሃለሁ።
በአሕዛብም ውስጥ የሚያውቁህ ሁሉ ያለቅሱልሃል፤ አንተም ለድንጋጤ ሆነሃል፤ እስከ ዘለዓለምም አትኖርም።”
የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፦
የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! ፊትህን ወደ ሲዶና አቅንተህ ትንቢት ተናገርባት፤ እንዲህም በል፦
ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ ሲዶና ሆይ! እነሆ በአንቺ ላይ ነኝ፤ በውስጥሽም እከብራለሁ፤ ፍርድንም በአደረግሁብሽ ጊዜ፥ በተቀደስሁብሽም ጊዜ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቂያለሽ።
ቸነፈርንም በአንቺ ላይ፥ ደምንም በጎዳናሽ ላይ እሰድዳለሁ፤ ከዙሪያሽም በላይሽ ባለ ሰይፍ የተወጉ በመካከልሽ ይወድቃሉ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።
ከእንግዲህም ወዲያ ለእስራኤል ቤት የሚወጋ እሾህ፥ በዙሪያቸውም ከአሉ ከናቋቸው ሁሉ የሚያቈስል ኩርንችት አይሆንም፤ እኔም ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።
ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ የእስራኤልን ቤት ከተበተኑባቸው አሕዛብ ዘንድ እሰበስባቸዋለሁ፤ በአሕዛብና በሕዝብ ፊትም እቀደስባቸዋለሁ፤ ለባሪያዬ ለያዕቆብም በሰጠኋት ምድራቸው ይቀመጣሉ።
ተዘልለውም ይቀመጡባታል፤ ቤቶችንም ይሠራሉ፤ ወይኑንም ይተክላሉ፤ በዙሪያቸውም በአሉ በሚንቋቸው ሁሉ ላይ ፍርድን በአደረግሁ ጊዜ ተዘልለው ይቀመጣሉ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር አምላካቸው፥ የአባቶቻቸውም አምላክ እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

sections.title: The prophecy concerning Egypt.

verses.text: በዐሥረኛው ዓመት በዐሥረኛው ወር ከወሩም በዐሥራ ሁለተኛው ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፦
“የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! ፊትህን በግብጽ ንጉሥ በፈርዖን ላይ አድርግ፤ በእርሱና በግብፅ ሁሉ ላይም ትንቢት ተናገር፤
እንዲህም በል፦ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ በወንዞች መካከል የሚተኛ፥ ወንዙ የእኔ ነው፤ ለራሴም ሠርቼዋለሁ የሚል ታላቅ ዘንዶ የግብፅ ንጉሥ ፈርዖን ሆይ! እነሆ በአንተ ላይ ነኝ።
በመንጋጋዎችህ መቃጥን አገባብሃለሁ፤ የወንዞችህንም ዓሦች ሁሉ ወደ ቅርፊትህ አጣብቃለሁ፤ ከወንዞችህም መካከል አወጣሃለሁ፤ የወንዞችህም ዓሦች ሁሉ ወደ ቅርፊትህ ይጣበቃሉ።
አንተንና የወንዞችህን ዓሦች ሁሉ ወደ ምድረ በዳ እጥላለሁ፤ በምድርም ፊት ላይ ትወድቃለህ እንጂ አትከማችም፤ አትሰበሰብምም፤ መብልም አድርጌ ለምድር አራዊትና ለሰማይ ወፎች ሰጥቼሃለሁ።
ለእስራኤል ቤት የሸንበቆ በትር ሁነሃቸዋልና በግብፅ የሚኖሩ ሁሉ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።
በእጅ በያዙህ ጊዜ ተሰበርህ፤ ጫንቃቸውንም ሁሉ አቈሰልህ፤ በተደገፉብህም ጊዜ ተሰበርህ፤ ወገባቸውንም ሁሉ አንቀጠቀጥህ።
“ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ እነሆ ሰይፍን አመጣብሃለሁ፦ ሰውንና እንስሳንም ከአንተ ዘንድ አጠፋለሁ።
የግብፅም ምድር ባድማና ውድማ ትሆናለች፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ፤ አንተ፦ ወንዙ የእኔ ነው፤ የሠራሁትም እኔ ነኝ ብለሃልና።
ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ በአንተና በወንዞችህ ላይ ነኝ፤ የግብፅንም ምድር ከሚግዶል ጀምሮ እስከ ሰዌኔና እስከ ኢትዮጵያ ዳርቻ ድረስ በጦርና በቸነፈር ውድማና ባድማ አደርጋታለሁ።
The foot of man shall not trample upon it; nor shall the hoof of beast tread upon it; until the end of forty years, no one shall dwell therein.

And I shall make the land of Egypt desolate among the desolate lands; and among the cities that are laid waste, her cities shall be desolate for forty years; and I shall scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and I shall disperse them throughout the countries.”
Thus saith the Lord God, “After forty years, I will gather the Egyptians from the peoples among whom they were scattered.
And I will bring back the captivity of Egypt; and to the land of their birth, to the land of Patros, I will return them; and there shall be a lowly kingdom.
And it shall be as before, a small kingdom shall be among the nations; and I will not suffer them to be great among the nations.
The house of Israel shall remember them, and they shall be a reproach to her; from now on, they shall not be a resting place for her; and they shall know that I am the Lord God.”

sections.title: And the king smote Egypt as he had done.

verses.text: And it came to pass; in the year of the one hundred and seventieth, in the first month, on the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came unto me, saying:

"O son of man! The king of Babylon hath made his army to serve in Tyre; they have made a strong work against her; every head is made bald, and every shoulder is peeled: yet hath he no wages, nor his army, for Tyre, for the service that they have taken against her."

Therefore thus saith the Lord God: Behold, I will give the land of Egypt unto the king of Babylon, and he shall take her multitude, and he shall spoil her, and he shall take her prey; and this shall be for the wages of his army.
"Because he hath wrought for me, and because he hath done service against Tyre, I will give him the land of Egypt for his wages," saith the Lord God.
"In that day will I cause a horn to bud for the house of Israel, and I will give thee a mouth opened in the midst of them; and they shall know that I am the Lord."

sections.title: The Lord shall smite Egypt.

verses.text: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying thus:
"O son of man! Prophesy, and say: Thus saith the Lord God: Woe! Say ye, for the day is at hand; alas!
The day is near; the day of the Lord is near; it shall be a day of clouds, a time of the nations' reckoning.
A sword shall come upon Egypt; and a blow shall be upon Ethiopia; and the slain shall fall in Egypt; and they shall take away much of her multitude; and her foundation shall be broken.
Ethiopia and Put, Lud and all Arabia, and the mixed multitude that dwell in the land, the children of the covenant shall fall by the sword with them.
"Thus saith the Lord: They that uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her power shall come down; from the least unto the greatest, they shall fall by the sword within her, saith the Lord God.
Among the nations that are in distress, they shall be in distress; and among the cities thereof, they shall be as horses among the cities.
And I will set fire upon Egypt; and when her helpers shall be broken, then shall they know that I am the Lord.
In that day, messengers shall go forth to destroy the Ethiopians from before me; and in Egypt, there shall be a blow upon them; behold, it cometh!
"Thus saith the Lord God: I will destroy the multitude of Egypt by the hand of the king of Babylon."
እርሱና ሕዝቡ የአሕዛብም ኀያላን ምድሪቱን ለማጥፋት ይላካሉ፤ ግብፃውያንንም በሰይፍ ይወጉአቸዋል፤ ምድሪቱም በሙታን ትሞላለች።
ወንዞችንም ምድረ በዳ አደርጋለሁ፤ ምድሪቱንም በክፉ ሰዎች እጅ እሰጣለሁ፥ ምድሪቱንና ሞላዋንም በባዕዳን እጅ ባድማ አደርጋለሁ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሬአለሁ።
“ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ ጣዖቶቹን አጠፋለሁ፤ ምስሎቹንም ከሜምፎስ እሽራለሁ፤ ከእንግዲህ ወዲያም በግብፅ ምድር አለቃ አይሆንም፤ በግብፅ ምድር ላይም ፍርሀትን አደርጋለሁ።
ጳትሮስንም አፈርሳለሁ፤ በጣኔዎስም ላይ እሳትን አነድዳለሁ፤ በዲዮስጶሊን ላይም ፍርድን አደርጋለሁ።
በግብፅም ኀይል በሲን ላይ መዓቴን አፈስሳለሁ፤ የሜምፎስንም ብዛት አጠፋለሁ።
በግብፅም ላይ እሳትን አነድዳለሁ፤ ሲንም ትታወካለች፤ ኖእም ትሰበራለች፤ ሜምፎስም ምድረ በዳ ትሆናለች።
የሄልዮቱ ከተማና የቡባስቱም ጐልማሶች በሰይፍ ይወድቃሉ፤ ሴቶችም ይማረካሉ።
የግብፅን ቀንበር በዚያ በሰበርሁ ጊዜ በጣፍናስ ቀኑ ይጨልማል፤ የኀይልዋም ትዕቢት ይጠፋባታል፤ ደመናም ይጋርዳታል፤ ሴቶች ልጆችዋም ይማረካሉ።
እንዲሁ በግብፅ ላይ ፍርድን አደርጋለሁ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።”
እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በዐሥራ አንደኛው ዓመት በመጀመሪያው ወር ከወሩም በሰባተኛው ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፦

"O son of man! I have broken the arm of Pharaoh, king of Egypt; behold, they shall not be able to stand against the healer, for they shall not be able to hold the sword, nor shall they be taken captive."
"Therefore, thus saith the Lord God: Behold, I am against Pharaoh, king of Egypt; I will break both the strong and the broken arm; and I will cause the sword to fall from his hand."
"And I will cause the Egyptians to fall among the nations, and I will scatter them among the countries."
"And I will break the arm of the king of Babylon; and I will give him my sword; and Egypt shall be a desolation, and her cities shall be laid waste; and her land shall be desolate."

"And I will break the arm of the king of Babylon; and the arm of Pharaoh shall fall; and when I give my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, he shall know that I am the Lord when I have scattered him in the land of Egypt."
"And I will cause the Egyptians to fall among the nations, and I will scatter them among the countries; and all shall know that I am the Lord."

sections.title: As a tree planted by the rivers of water.

verses.text: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በዐሥራ አንደኛው ዓመት በሦስተኛው ወር ከወሩም በመጀመሪያው ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፦
“የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! የግብፅን ንጉሥ ፈርዖንንና ሕዝቡን እንዲህ በላቸው፦ በታላቅነትህ ማንን ትመስላለህ?
እነሆ አሦር ጫፉ እንደ ተዋበ፥ ችፍግነቱ ጥላ እንደ ሰጠ፥ ቁመቱም እንደ ረዘመ፥ ራሱም ወደ ደመናዎች እንደ ደረሰ እንደ ሊባኖስ ዝግባ ነበረ።
ውኃም አበቀለው፥ ቀላይም አሳደገው፥ ወንዞችም በተተከለበት ዙሪያ ይጎርፉ ነበር፤ ፈሳሾቹንም ወደ ምድረ በዳ ዛፍ ሁሉ ላከ።
ስለዚህ ቁመቱ ከምድረ በዳ ዛፍ ሁሉ በላይ ከፍ ከፍ አለ፤ ቅርንጫፎቹም በዙ፤ ጫፎቹም ከብዙ ውኆች የተነሣ ረዘሙ።
የሰማይም ወፎች ሁሉ በቅርንጫፎቹ ላይ ተዋለዱ፤ የምድርም አራዊት ሁሉ ከጫፎቹ በታች ተዋለዱ፤ ከጥላውም በታች ታላላቆች አሕዛብ ሁሉ ይቀመጡ ነበር።
ሥሩም በብዙ ውኃ አጠገብ ነበረና በታላቅነቱና በጫፎቹ ርዝመት የተዋበ ነበረ።
በእግዚአብሔር ገነት የነበሩ ዝግባዎች አይተካከሉትም፥ ጥዶችም ቅርንጫፎቹን፥ አስታ የሚባለውም ዛፍ ጫፎቹን አይመሳሰሉትም ነበር፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ገነት ዛፍ ሁሉ በውበቱ አይመስለውም ነበር።
በጫፎቹ ብዛት ውብ አደረግሁት፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ገነት በዔድን የነበሩ ዛፎች ሁሉ ቀኑበት።
“ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ ቁመትህ ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአልና፥ ራስህም በደመናት መካከል ደርሶአልና፤ ትዕቢቱንም አየሁ፤
I shall deliver them into the hands of the rulers of the nations; and he shall deal with them according to the measure of the wicked; and I shall bring them to ruin.

The people of another nation, who are the enemies of Israel, shall be cast down; in all the mountains and in all the valleys, their branches shall be broken; and their roots shall be gathered together upon the face of the earth; and all the nations of the earth shall turn back from their evil.
Upon the fallen tree, all the birds of the heavens shall dwell; and all the beasts of the earth shall be upon its branches.

All the trees that are by the waters shall not be moved; and they shall not reach unto the clouds; and those trees that drink of the waters shall not be mingled with him, for all shall go down to the grave among those who descend to death.

"Thus saith the Lord God: On the day when I brought them down to Sheol, I caused the lamentation to cease; and I covered the deep for him; and the mighty ones were astonished; and I made Lebanon to mourn for him; and all the trees of the forest shall wither for him."

And when I brought them down to the pit, I caused the sound of their fall to be heard; and all who drink of the waters, the choice and the goodly cedars of Lebanon, and the trees of Eden shall be comforted in the lower parts of the earth.
And they shall descend with him into the sword, and they shall be cast down to Sheol with him; and those who dwelt under the shadow of the mighty shall be lost among the nations.

"In glory and in greatness, whom dost thou resemble among the trees of Eden? Yet thou shalt be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the lower parts of the earth; thou shalt lie among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword." Thus saith the Lord God.

sections.title: Concerning the king of Egypt, concerning Pharaoh.

verses.text: And it came to pass, in the second year of the second month, on the first day of the month, that the word of the Lord came unto me, saying:

"O son of man! Concerning Pharaoh king of Egypt, prophesy and say unto him: Thus saith the Lord God; Thou art like a young lion among the nations, but thou art as a sea monster; thou dost come forth with thy rivers, and trouble the waters with thy feet, and foul their rivers."
Thus saith the Lord God: I will therefore spread my net over thee with a company of many people; and they shall bring thee up in my net.

I will leave thee upon the land, and I will cast thee forth upon the open field; and I will cause all the fowls of the heaven to settle upon thee, and I will fill the beasts of the whole earth with thee.
I will lay thy flesh upon the mountains, and fill the valleys with thy height.
I will also water with thy blood the land even to the mountains; and the rivers shall be full of thee.
When I shall put thee out, I will cover the heaven, and make the stars thereof dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give her light.
All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over thee, and set darkness upon thy land, saith the Lord God.
At the noise of thy fall the nations shall tremble; when I bring thy destruction among the nations, into the countries which thou hast not known.

I will make many people amazed at thee; and their kings shall be sore afraid for thee, when I shall brandish my sword before them; and they shall tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of thy fall."
The Lord God saith, “The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee.
With a mighty sword I shall strike thy strength; all the enemies of the nations are they; they shall consume the pride of Egypt; her strength shall be utterly broken.
I shall destroy all the beasts that are beside much water; from henceforth shall no foot of man tread upon them, nor shall the hoof of beast trample upon them.
At that time I shall gather their waters; and their rivers shall flow like oil, saith the Lord God.
When I made the land of Egypt desolate and waste, in the time when the land was utterly destroyed, all that dwelt therein shall know that I am the Lord God.
Behold, it is a desolation; it shall be desolate; the daughters of the nations shall be desolate; concerning Egypt and all her strength shall it be desolate,” saith the Lord God.

sections.title: Moses concerning Egypt

verses.text: And it came to pass, in the second year of the tenth month, on the first day of the month, that the word of the Lord came unto me, saying:

"O son of man! Lift up a lamentation concerning the power of Egypt; and say unto her, and to the daughters of her mighty ones, that they shall go down to the pit with those that descend into the grave."
Who is it that excels in beauty? Go down and be joined with those who are uncut.
In the midst of those slain by the sword, they shall fall with him by the sword; and all their might shall perish; they shall lie down with the uncircumcised and with the multitude."
The mighty leaders shall speak with their helpers in Sheol; and those who were slain by the sword shall lie down unburied.
"Assyria and all her hosts shall fall there; all of them shall be slain by the sword; they shall lie down round about her, and all shall fall by the sword."
Their graves are in the innermost part of the pit; her assembly is round about her grave; all who were slain by the sword shall lie down unburied.

"Elam is there; all her multitude is round about her grave; all who were slain by the sword shall lie down unburied; they have gone down to the pit, and they have found their punishment with those who descend into the grave."

Among the slain, they shall make their bed with all the multitude; her grave is round about her; all who were not slain and were killed by the sword are there; they were laid to rest in the land of the living; and they have borne their shame with those who descend into the grave."
"Meshech and Tubal, and all their multitude, are there; their graves are round about them; all of them, unburied, have been slain by the sword; they were laid to rest in the land of the living."

In the land of the living, the mighty were cast down; they bore their weapons and descended to Sheol, their swords beneath them, and their iniquities upon their bones, for they shall lie with the slain who have not been buried.
Thou also shalt be broken among them; with the slain by the sword shalt thou lie.
“Edom and her kings, all her princes are there; they shall lie with the slain by the sword.

They are not buried, and they lie with those who descend to the pit; all the princes of the north, all the Sidonians, are there with the slain; in the terror that was upon them, they are brought low; they lie with the slain who have not been buried, and they bear their shame with those who descend to the pit.
“The slain by the sword, Pharaoh and all his host, they shall see; for Pharaoh shall be comforted concerning all his strength, saith the Lord God.
I have made thy bed in the land of the living; Pharaoh and all his host shall lie with the slain, among those who have not been buried,” saith the Lord God.

sections.title: Ezekiel, the watchman of Israel.

verses.text: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፦
“የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! ለሕዝብህ ልጆች ተናገር እንዲህም በላቸው፦ ጦርን በምድር ላይ በአመጣሁ ጊዜ፥ የምድር ሕዝብ ከመካከላቸው አንድ ሰውን ወስደው ለራሳቸው ጕበኛ ቢያደርጉ፥
እርሱም በምድር ላይ የመጣውን ጦር በአየ ጊዜ መለከትን ቢነፋ፥ ሕዝቡንም ቢያስጠነቅቅ፤
የመለከቱን ድምፅ የሚሰማ ሰው ባይጠነቀቅ፥ ጦር መጥቶ ቢወስደው፥ ደሙ በራሱ ላይ ይሆናል።
የመለከቱን ድምፅ ሰምቶ ስላልተጠነቀቀ ደሙ በራሱ ላይ ይሆናል፤ ቢጠነቀቅስ ኖሮ ነፍሱን በአዳነ ነበር።
ጕበኛው ግን ጦር ሲመጣ ቢያይ፥ መለከቱንም ባይነፋ፥ ሕዝቡንም ባያስጠነቅቅ፥ ጦርም መጥቶ አንድ ሰው ከእነርሱ ቢወስድ፥ እርሱ በኀጢአቱ ተወስዶአል፤ ደሙን ግን ከጕበኛው እጅ እፈልጋለሁ።
“አንተም የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! ለእስራኤል ቤት ጕበኛ አድርጌሃለሁ፤ ከአፌ ቃሌን ስማ፤ ከእኔም ዘንድ አስጠንቅቃቸው።
ኀጢአተኛውን፦ ኀጢአተኛ ሆይ! በርግጥ ትሞታለህ ባልሁ ጊዜ፥ ኀጢአተኛውን ከክፉ መንገዱ ታስጠነቅቅ ዘንድ ባትናገር፥ ያ ኀጢአተኛ በኀጢአቱ ይሞታል፤ ደሙን ግን ከእጅህ እፈልጋለሁ።
ነገር ግን ከመንገዱ ይመለስ ዘንድ ኀጢአተኛውን ብታስጠነቅቀው፥ እርሱም ከመንገዱ ባይመለስ፥ በኀጢአቱ ይሞታል፤ አንተ ግን ነፍስህን ታድናለህ።
“አንተም የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! የእስራኤልን ቤት፦ እናንተ፦ በደላችንና ኀጢአታችን በላያችን አሉ፤ እኛም ሰልስለንባቸዋል፤ እንዴትስ በሕይወት እንኖራለን? ብላችሁ ተናግራችኋል በላቸው።

For I am alive, says the Lord God, and I do not take pleasure in the death of the wicked, but rather that the wicked turn from their way and live. O house of Israel, return! Why will you die in your sins?

And thou, O son of man! Speak to the children of thy people, saying: On the day when the righteous turn from his righteousness, he shall not live; and the wicked, when he turns from his wickedness, shall not be saved; the righteous shall not live by his righteousness in the day when he sins.
As for me, the righteous shall surely live; but if he turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he shall die in it; and the righteous shall not be remembered for his righteousness.
And I, the wicked, if I turn from my wickedness and do what is lawful and right, I shall surely live.
If the wicked returns from his transgression and pays back what he has taken by robbery, if he walks in the statutes of life, and does no iniquity, he shall surely live; he shall not die.
All his transgressions that he has committed shall not be remembered against him; he has done what is lawful and right; he shall surely live.
"The children of thy people say, 'The way of the Lord is not equal'; but as for them, their way is not equal.
When the righteous turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he shall die in it.
And if the wicked turns from his wickedness and does what is lawful and right, he shall surely live.
But ye say, 'The way of the Lord is not equal.' O house of Israel, I will judge you, every one according to his ways.

sections.title: The Fall of Jerusalem

verses.text: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በተማረክን በዐሥራ ሁለተኛው ዓመት በዐሥረኛው ወር ከወሩም በአምስተኛው ቀን ከኢየሩሳሌም ያመለጠ አንድ ሰው ወደ እኔ መጥቶ፦ ከተማዪቱ ተያዘች አለኝ።
ያመለጠውም ሳይመጣ በመሸ ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔር እጅ በእኔ ላይ ነበረች፤ በነጋውም ወደ እኔ እስኪመጣ ድረስ አፌን ከፈተ፤ አፌም ተከፈተች፤ ከዚያም በኋላ እኔ ዲዳ አልሆንሁም።
የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፥
“የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! በእስራኤል ምድር በአሉ በባድማ ስፍራዎች የተቀመጡ፦ አብርሃም ብቻውን ሳለ ምድሪቱን ወረሰ፤ እኛም ብዙዎች ነን፤ ምድሪቱም ርስት ሆና ለእኛ ተሰጥታለች ይላሉ። ስለዚህ እንዲህ በላቸው፦
ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ ከደም ጋር ትበላላችሁ፤ ዐይናችሁንም ወደ ጣዖቶቻችሁ ታነሣላችሁ፤ ደምንም ታፈስሳላችሁ፤ በውኑ ምድሪቱን ትወርሳላችሁን?
ሰይፋችሁን ይዛችሁ ቆማችኋል፤ ርኩስ ነገርን ታደርጋላችሁ፤ የባልንጀሮቻችሁንም ሚስቶች ታስነውራላችሁ፤ በውኑ ምድሪቱን ትወርሳላችሁን? ስለዚህም እንዲህ በላቸው፦
ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ እኔ ሕያው ነኝና በባድማ ስፍራዎች ያሉ በሰይፍ ይወድቃሉ፤ በምድረ በዳ ያለውን ለአራዊት መብል አድርጌ እሰጣለሁ፤ በአምባዎችና በዋሻዎች ያሉ በቸነፈር ይሞታሉ።
ምድሪቱንም ባድማና ውድማ አደርጋታለሁ፤ የኀይልዋም ስድብ ይቀራል፤ የእስራኤልም ተራሮች ባድማ ይሆናሉ፤ ማንም አያልፍባቸውም።
ስላደረጉትም ርኵሰት ሁሉ ምድሪቱን ባድማና ውድማ ባደረግሁ ጊዜ፥ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።
“አንተም የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! የሕዝብህ ልጆች በቅጥር አጠገብና በቤት ደጆች ውስጥ ስለ አንተ ይናገራሉ፤ እርስ በርሳቸውም አንዱ ከአንዱ ጋር፦ እንሂድና እግዚአብሔር የሚለውን ቃል እንስማ ይላሉ።

The people come to You as they come; as My people they stand before You; they hear Your words; yet they do not do them; for with their mouths they show much love, but their hearts pursue their own idols.
Behold, You are as one who sings a beautiful song, one who plays an instrument well; they hear Your words, yet they do not do them.
And they say, "Behold, this comes; when it comes, they will know that a prophet has been among them."

sections.title: The servants of Israel

verses.text: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፦
“የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! ትንቢት ተናገር፤ በእስራኤል እረኞች ላይ ትንቢት ተናገር፤ እረኞችንም እንዲህ በላቸው፦ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ ራሳቸውን ለሚያሰማሩ ለእስራኤል እረኞች ወዮላቸው! እረኞች ራሳቸውን ያሰማራሉን? እረኞች በጎችን ያሰማሩ ዘንድ አይገባቸውምን?
ወተቱን ትጠጣላችሁ፤ ጠጕሩንም ትለብሳላችሁ፤ የወፈሩትን ታርዳላችሁ፤ በጎቹን ግን አታሰማሩም።
የደከመውን አላጸናችሁትም፤ የታመመውንም አልፈወሳችሁትም፤ የተሰበረውንም አልጠገናችሁትም፤ የባዘነውንም አልመለሳችሁትም፤ የጠፋውንም አልፈለጋችሁትም፤ በኀይልና በጭቈናም ገዛችኋቸው።
በጎችም እረኛን በማጣት ተበተኑ፤ ለዱርም አራዊት ሁሉ መብል ሆኑ።
በጎች በተራሮች ሁሉና በረዘሙ ኮረብቶች ሁሉ ላይ ተበትነዋል፤ በጎችም በምድር ፊት ሁሉ ላይ ተበትነዋል፤ የሚፈልግም አልነበረም፤ የሚመልስም አልነበረም።
“ስለዚህ እረኞች ሆይ! የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፤
ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ እኔ ሕያው ነኝና እረኞች ስለሌሉ፥ እረኞችም በጎችን ስላልፈለጉ፥ እረኞችም ራሳቸውን እንጂ በጎችን ስላላሰማሩ፥ በጎች ንጥቂያ ሆነዋልና፥ በጎችም ለዱር አራዊት ሁሉ መብል ሆነዋልና፤
ስለዚህ እረኞች ሆይ! የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ።
ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ እነሆ በእረኞች ላይ ነኝ፤ በጎችንም ከእጃቸው እፈልጋለሁ፤ በጎችንም ከማሰማራት አስተዋቸዋለሁ፤ ከዚያም ወዲያ እረኞች በጎችን አያሰማሩም፤ በጎችንም ከአፋቸው አድናለሁ፤ መብልም አይሆኑላቸውም።
"Thus saith the Lord God: Behold, I Myself will seek out My sheep; I will care for them."

"As a shepherd seeks out his flock on the day when he is among his scattered sheep, so will I seek out My sheep; I will gather them from all the countries where they have been scattered on the day of clouds and thick darkness."

"And I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the countries, and I will bring them to their own land; and I will feed them upon the mountains of Israel, by the rivers, and in all the inhabited places of the land."

"I will feed them in a good pasture; and their fold shall be upon the high mountains of Israel; there shall they lie in a good fold, and in a fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel."
"I Myself will feed My sheep, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord God. And they shall know that I am the Lord their God."

"I will seek that which was lost, and bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick; but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment."
"Thus saith the Lord God: Behold, I, even I, will search for My sheep, and will seek them out."
"Is it not enough for you to have trampled down My good pasture with your feet, and to have drunk of the clear waters with your feet, that you must also trample down the residue with your feet?"
"And My sheep shall eat that which you have trampled with your feet, and they shall drink that which you have fouled with your feet."
"Therefore thus saith the Lord God unto them: Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep."
እስክትበትኑአቸው ድረስ በእንቢያና በትከሻ ስለምትገፉአቸው፥ የደከሙትንም ሁሉ በቀንዳችሁ ስለምትወጉአቸው፥
ስለዚህ መንጋዬን አድናለሁ፤ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህም ንጥቂያ አይሆኑም፤ በበግና በበግ መካከልም እፈርዳለሁ።
በላያቸውም አንድ እረኛ አቆማለሁ፤ እርሱም ያሰማራቸዋል፤ እርሱም ባሪያዬ ዳዊት ነው፤ እረኛም ይሆናቸዋል።
እኔም እግዚአብሔር አምላክ እሆናቸዋለሁ፤ ባሪያዬ ዳዊትም በመካከላቸው አለቃ ይሆናል፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሬአለሁ።
“የሰላምንም ቃል ኪዳን ከዳዊት ቤት ጋር አደርጋለሁ፤ ክፉዎችንም አራዊት ከምድር አጠፋለሁ፤ ተዘልለውም በምድረ በዳ ይኖራሉ፤ በዱርም ውስጥ ይተኛሉ።
እነርሱንና በኮረብታዬ ዙሪያ ያሉትን ስፍራዎች እባርካቸዋለሁ፤ ዝናቡንም በጊዜው አወርዳለሁ፤ የበረከትም ዝናብ ይሆናል።
የምድረ በዳ ዛፍም ፍሬውን ይሰጣል፤ ምድርም ቡቃያዋን ትሰጣለች፤ በምድራቸውም በሰላም ታምነው ይኖራሉ፤ የቀንበራቸውንም ማነቆ በሰበርሁ ጊዜ፥ ከሚገዙአቸውም እጅ ባዳንኋቸው ጊዜ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።
እንግዲህ ለአሕዛብ ንጥቂያ አይሆኑም፤ የምድርም አራዊት አይበሉአቸዋም፤ ተዘልለውም ይቀመጣሉ፤ የሚያስፈራቸውም የለም።
የሰላምን ተክል አቆምላቸዋለሁ፤ እንግዲህም ከራብ የተነሣ በምድር አያልቁም፤ የአሕዛብንም ስድብ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይሸከሙም።
እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካቸው ከእነርሱ ጋር እንዳለሁ፥ እነርሱም የእስራኤል ቤት ሕዝቤ እንደ ሆኑ ያውቃሉ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።
"And ye are sheep, the sheep of My pasture; ye are men, and I am your God, saith the Lord God."

sections.title: The prophecy concerning Edom.

verses.text: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፦
“የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! ፊትህን ወደ ሴይር ተራራ መልስ፤ ትንቢትም ተናገርበት፤
እንዲህም በለው፦ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ የሴይር ተራራ ሆይ! እነሆ በአንተ ላይ ነኝ፤ እጄን እዘረጋብሃለሁ፤ ባድማና ውድማም አደርግሃለሁ።
ከተሞችህንም አፈራርሳቸዋለሁ፤ አንተም ባድማ ትሆናለህ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃለህ።
የዘለዓለም ጠላት ሁነሃልና፥ በመከራቸውም ጊዜ በኀይለኛይቱ የኀጢአታቸው ቀጠሮ ጊዜ የእስራኤልን ልጆች በሰይፍ እጅ ጥለሃቸዋልና፤
ስለዚህ እኔ ሕያው ነኝ! በደም እንደ በደልህ ደም ያሳድድሃል፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።
የሴይርንም ተራራ ውድማ አደርገዋለሁ፤ ሰውንና እንስሳውንም አጠፋለሁ።
ተራሮችህንም በተገደሉት ሰዎች እሞላለሁ፤ በኮረብቶችህና በሸለቆዎችህ፥ በፈሳሾችህም ሁሉ ላይ በሰይፍ የተገደሉት ሁሉ ይወድቃሉ።
ለዘለዓለምም ባድማ አደርግሃለሁ፤ ከተሞችህም ሰው የማይኖርባቸው ይሆናሉ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃለህ።
“እግዚአብሔርም በዚያ ሳለ፥ አንተ፥ እነዚህ ሁለቱ ሕዝቦች፥ እነዚህም ሁለቱ ሀገሮች ለእኔ ይሆናሉ፤ እኔም እወርሳቸዋለሁ ብለሃልና፤

Therefore, I am alive! As your anger is measured, so I shall measure them; and as your wrath has been poured out upon them, I shall judge you according to your righteousness, saith the Lord God; and in the time of my judgment upon them, you shall be known to me.
And you said: "They have been judged; they have been given as food for us," and concerning all the proclamations you have spoken upon the mountains of Israel, I, the Lord God, have indeed heard them.
You have lifted your mouth high against me, as you have done; I have indeed heard it.
The Lord God saith, "When all the earth rejoices, I shall make you desolate."

Because the house of Israel has become desolate, you shall rejoice upon it; thus shall I deal with you; O mountain of Seir! You and all Edom shall become desolate; and I, the Lord, shall be known as I am.

sections.title: The blessing of the Lord upon Israel.

verses.text: "O son of man! Prophesy against the mountains of Israel, and say, O mountains of Israel! Hear the word of the Lord God."
"Thus saith the Lord God: The enemy is upon you; behold! It has become a desolation for eternity, and it has become a heritage for us."

"Therefore prophesy, and say: Thus saith the Lord God: For the remnant of the nations shall be your heritage, for the nations that are around you have made you desolate; you shall be desolate, and you shall become a refuge for the speaking ones and a dwelling place for the nations."

"Therefore, O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord God. Thus saith the Lord God to the mountains and to the hills, to the rivers and to the valleys, to the desolate places, to the cities that are forsaken, which have become a prey and a derision to the remnant of the nations that are around."

"Therefore thus saith the Lord God: I will cause them to rejoice and to be glad in their hearts, and in their souls I will give them the land as a heritage, and I will speak against the remnant of the nations and against all Edomites with the fire of my jealousy."

"Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel; to the mountains and to the hills, to the rivers and to the valleys, say: Thus saith the Lord God: Behold, because you have borne the reproach of the nations, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my fury."
"Therefore thus saith the Lord God: I have lifted my hand against the nations that are around you; they shall bear their shame."
"O mountains of Israel! My people shall come to you, for they shall bring hope and they shall eat your fruits."
"Behold, I am for you; and I will look upon you; and you shall be tilled; you shall be sown."
"And I will multiply the house of Israel, all of them; they shall dwell in the cities; and the desolate places shall be inhabited."

I have multiplied both man and beast; and they shall increase abundantly; they shall be fruitful; and as I have nourished you like your ancestors, I will do good unto you as I did before; and you shall know that I am the Lord your God.
I have multiplied men, even my people Israel, upon you; and they shall inherit you; and you shall be their heritage; from henceforth there shall be no barren child among you.
Thus saith the Lord God: They shall say, “You are a man of high standing; for in the midst of your people, you have caused your children to be cast away.”
Therefore, let not the barren man be high among you; neither let the barren child among your people be made; thus saith the Lord God.

Neither shall the barren man remember the covenant of the nations; nor shall the barren man bear the burden of the nations; neither shall the barren man cause your people to be forsaken,” saith the Lord God.

sections.title: The New Life of Israel

verses.text: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying:
"O son of man! When the house of Israel dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their own way and by their doings; their way was before me as the uncleanness of a removed woman."
"Therefore I poured out my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land, and for their idols wherewith they had polluted it."
"And I scattered them among the nations, and dispersed them through the countries; according to their way and according to their doings I judged them."
"And when they entered unto the nations, whither they went, they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These are the people of the Lord, and are gone forth out of his land."
"But I had pity for mine holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations, whither they went."

"Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God; I do not this for your sakes, O house of Israel, but for mine holy name's sake, which ye have profaned among the nations, whither ye went."

"And I will sanctify my great name, which was profaned among the nations, which ye have profaned in the midst of them; and the nations shall know that I am the Lord, saith the Lord God, when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes."
"For I will take you from among the nations, and gather you out of all countries, and will bring you into your own land."
"Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean; from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you."
አዲስ ልብንም እሰጣችኋለሁ፤ አዲስ መንፈስንም በውስጣችሁ አኖራለሁ፤ የድንጋዩንም ልብ ከሥጋችሁ አወጣለሁ፤ የሥጋንም ልብ እሰጣችኋለሁ።
መንፈሴንም በውስጣችሁ አኖራለሁ፤ በትእዛዜም እንድትሄዱ አደርጋችኋለሁ፤ ፍርዴንም ትጠብቃላችሁ ታደርጉትማላችሁ።
ለአባቶቻችሁም በሰጠኋት ምድር ትኖራላችሁ፤ ሕዝብም ትሆኑኛላችሁ፤ እኔም አምላክ እሆናችኋለሁ።
ከርኵሰታችሁም ሁሉ አድናችኋለሁ፤ እህልንም እጠራዋለሁ፤ አበዛውማለሁ፤ ራብንም አላመጣባችሁም።
ደግሞም የራብን ስድብ ከአሕዛብ ዘንድ እንዳትሸከሙ የዛፍን ፍሬና የእርሻውን መከር አበዛለሁ።
ክፉውን መንገዳችሁንና መልካም ያይደለውን ሥራችሁንም ታስባላችሁ፤ ስለ በደላችሁና ስለ ርኵሰታችሁም ራሳችሁን ትጸየፋላችሁ።
ይህን የሠራሁ ስለ እናንተ እንዳይደለ በእናንተ ዘንድ የታወቀ ይሁን፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ! ስለ መንገዳችሁ እፈሩና ተዋረዱ።
“ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ ከኀጢአታችሁ ሁሉ በአነጻኋችሁ ጊዜ በከተሞች ሰዎችን አኖራለሁ፤ ባድማዎቹም ስፍራዎች ይሠራሉ።
ባድማ የነበረች፥ በመንገደኛም ሁሉ ዐይን ዘንድ ባድማ የነበረች ምድር ትታረሳለች።
ሰዎችም ባድማ የነበረች ይህች ምድር እንደ ዔድን ገነት ሆናለች፤ የፈረሱት፥ ባድማ የሆኑት፥ የጠፉትም ከተሞች ተመሽገዋል፤ ሰውም የሚኖርባቸው ሆነዋል ይላሉ።

And concerning those nations that remain round about you, I, the Lord your God, have made their places desolate, as I have done; and they shall know that I am the Lord, for I have spoken, and I will do it.
"Thus saith the Lord God: Therefore, I will also do this unto them, that the house of Israel may be ashamed; and I will multiply man as the grass of the field."
As the holy ones are gathered, on the day of their feasts, as it is in Jerusalem, so shall the cities that are made desolate be filled with men; and they shall know that I am the Lord."
And the hand of the Lord was upon me; and the Lord brought me forth by the Spirit, and set me down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones.
And He caused me to pass round about them; behold, there were very many in the open valley; and lo, they were very dry.
And He said unto me, “Son of man, can these bones live?” And I answered, “O Lord God, Thou knowest.”
Again He said unto me, “Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the Lord.”
Thus saith the Lord God unto these bones; “Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live.”
And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.”
So I prophesied as I was commanded; and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold, a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.
And when I beheld, lo, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them.

Then said He unto me, “Son of man, prophesy unto the wind; prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, Thus saith the Lord God; Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.”
So I prophesied as He commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.
And the Lord spoke unto me, saying, “O son of man! Behold, these bones are the whole house of Israel; behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost; we are cut off for our parts.’
Therefore prophesy, and say unto them: Thus saith the Lord God: O my people! Behold, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Israel.
O my people! When I open your graves, and bring you up out of your graves, ye shall know that I am the Lord your God.
And I will put my Spirit within you, and ye shall live; and I will place you in your own land; and ye shall know that I the Lord have spoken it and performed it, saith the Lord God.”

sections.title: For the kingdom of Judah and the kingdom of Israel is one.

verses.text: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying thus:

"Thou, son of man! Take a rod, and write upon it: For Judah and for the children of Israel his companions; and take another rod, and write upon it: For Joseph, the rod of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel his companions."
"And let them be one rod in thine hand; and they shall become one in thy hand."
"And concerning the children of thy people, dost thou not say, 'What dost thou mean by these?' When thou speakest unto them, thou shalt say, 'Thus saith the Lord God.'"

"Behold, I will take the rod of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his fellows; and will put them with him, even with the rod of Judah, and make them one rod, and they shall be one in mine hand."
"And the rods whereon thou writest shall be in thine hand before their eyes."

"And say unto them, 'Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land.'"

"And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king to them all; and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all."

"Neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions; but I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people, and I will be their God."
"And my servant David shall be king over them; and they all shall have one shepherd: they shall also walk in my judgments, and observe my statutes, and do them."

Your fathers dwelt in this land; they shall dwell in the land which I gave to My servant Jacob; they and their children, and their children's children shall dwell therein forever; and My servant David shall be their leader forever.
I will make a covenant of peace with them; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them; and I will establish them and multiply them, and I will set My sanctuary in their midst forever.
My dwelling place also shall be with them; and I will be their God, and they shall be My people.
When My sanctuary is in their midst forever, then the people shall know that I, the Lord, sanctify Israel.”

sections.title: Gog shall be as a weapon of the Lord, rising up as it is ordained.

verses.text: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፦
“የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! ፊትህን በጎግ ላይና በማጎግ ምድር ላይ፥ በሮስ በሞሳሕና በቶቤል አለቃ ላይ አቅናበት፤ ትንቢትም ተናገርበት፤
እንዲህም በል፦ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ የሮስ፥ የሞሣሕና የቶቤል አለቃ ጎግ ሆይ! እነሆ! እኔ በአንተ ላይ ነኝ።
እመልስህማለሁ፤ በመንጋጋህም ልጓም አገባብሃለሁ፤ አንተንና ሠራዊትህን ሁሉ፥ ፈረሶችንና ፈረሰኞችን፥ የጦር ልብስ የለበሱትን ሁሉ፥ ጋሻና ራስ ቍርን፥ ሰይፍንም የያዙትን ሁሉ አወጣለሁ።
ፋርስንና ኢትዮጵያን፥ ሊብያንም፥ ከእነርሱ ጋር ጋሻና የራስ ቍርን የለበሱትን ሁሉ፥
ጎሜርንና ከእርሱ ጋር ያሉትን ሁሉ፥ በሰሜን ዳርቻም ያለውን የቴርጋማን ቤትና ጭፍሮቹን ሁሉ፥ ብዙዎችንም ሕዝቦች ከአንተ ጋር አወጣለሁ።
“አንተና ወደ አንተ የተሰበሰቡ ወገኖችህ ሁሉ ተዘጋጁ፤ አንተም ራስህን አዘጋጅተህ ጠባቂ ሁናቸው።
ከብዙ ዘመንም በኋላ ትፈለጋለህ፤ በኋለኛውም ዘመን፥ የዘለዓለም ባድማ በነበሩ በእስራኤል ተራሮች ላይ ከብዙ ሕዝብ ውስጥ ወደ ተሰበሰበች፥ ከሰይፍ ወደ ተመለሰች ምድር ትገባለህ፤ እርስዋም ከሕዝብ ውስጥ ወጥታለች፤ ሁሉም በሰላም ይቀመጡበታል።
እንደ ዝናም ትወጣለህ፤ እንደ ደመናም ምድርን ትሸፍን ዘንድ ትደርሳለህ፤ አንተም ከብዙ ሕዝብና ሠራዊት ጋር ትወድቃለህ።”
ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፥ “በዚያ ቀን ነገር ወደ ልብህ ይገባል፥ ክፉ አሳብንም ታስባለህ፤ እንዲህም ትላለህ፦
ወደ ጠፋች ሀገር እወጣለሁ፤ ተዘልለው በሰላም ወደሚኖሩ፥ ሁላቸው ሳይፈሩ ያለ ቅጥርና ያለ መወርወሪያ፥ ያለ መዝጊያም ወደሚቀመጡባት ምድር እገባለሁ፤
ምርኮን ትማርክ ዘንድ፥ ብዝበዛንም ትበዘብዝ ዘንድ፥ ባድማም በነበሩ፥ አሁንም ሰዎች በሚኖሩባቸው ስፍራዎች ላይ፥ ከአሕዛብም በተሰበሰበ፥ ከብትና ዕቃንም በአገኘ፥ በምድርም መካከል በተቀመጠ ሕዝብ ላይ እጅህን ትመልሳለህ።
ሳባና ድዳን፥ የተርሴስም ነጋዴዎች፥ መንደሮችዋም ሁሉ፦ ምርኮን ትማርክ ዘንድ መጥተሃልን? ብዝበዛንስ ትበዘብዝ ዘንድ፥ ብርንና ወርቅንስ ትወስድ ዘንድ፥ ከብትንና ዕቃንስ ትወስድ ዘንድ፥ እጅግስ ብዙ ምርኮ ትማርክ ዘንድ ወገንህን ሰብስበሃልን? ይሉሃል።”
አንተ የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! ስለዚህ ትንቢት ተናገር፤ ጎግንም እንዲህ በለው፥ “ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ በዚያ ቀን ሕዝቤ እስራኤል በሰላም በተቀመጠ ጊዜ አንተ የምትነሣ አይደለምን?
አንተም፥ ከአንተም ጋር ብዙ ሕዝብ ሁላቸው በፈረሶች ላይ የተቀመጡ፥ ታላቅ ወገንና ብርቱ ሠራዊት፥ ከሰሜን ዳርቻ ከስፍራችሁ ትመጣላችሁ።
ምድርንም ትሸፍን ዘንድ እንደ ደመና በሕዝቤ በእስራኤል ላይ ትወጣለህ። በኋለኛው ዘመን ይሆናል፤ ጎግ ሆይ! በፊታቸው በተቀደስሁብህ ጊዜ፥ አሕዛብ ያውቁኝ ዘንድ በምድሬ ላይ አወጣሃለሁ።
“ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ለጎግ እንዲህ ይላል፦ በእነርሱ ላይ እንደማመጣህ፥ በዚያች ዘመን ብዙ ዓመት ትንቢት በተናገሩ በባሪያዎች በእስራኤል ነቢያት እጅ በቀደመው ዘመን ስለ እርሱ የተናገርሁ አንተ ነህን?
በዚያም ቀን ጎግ በእስራኤል ምድር ላይ በመጣ ጊዜ መቅሠፍቴ በመዓቴ ይመጣል ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።
በቅንአቴና በመዓቴ እሳት ተናግሬአለሁ፦ በእርግጥ በዚያ ቀን በእስራኤል ምድር ጽኑ መናወጥ ይሆናል፤
ከእግዚአብሔርም ፊት የተነሣ የባሕር ዓሣዎችና የሰማይ ወፎች፥ የምድረ በዳም አራዊት፥ በምድርም ላይ የሚንቀሳቀሱ ተንቀሳቃሾች ሁሉ፥ በምድርም ላይ የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ሁሉ ይንቀጠቀጣሉ፤ ተራሮችም ይገለባበጣሉ፤ ገዳላገደሎችም ይወድቃሉ፤ ቅጥርም ሁሉ ወደ ምድር ይወድቃል።
በተራሮችም ሁሉ በእርሱ ላይ ፍርሀትን እጠራለሁ፤ የሰውም ሁሉ ሰይፍ በወንድሙ ላይ ይሆናል፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።
በቸነፈርና በደም እፈርድበታለሁ፤ ዶፍም፥ የበረዶም ድንጋይ፥ እሳትና ድኝም በእርሱና በጭፍሮቹ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር በአሉ በብዙ ሕዝብ ላይ አዘንባለሁ።
ታላቅ እሆናለሁ፤ እቀደስማለሁ፤ እመሰገናለሁም፤ በብዙ አሕዛብም ዐይን የታወቅሁ እሆናለሁ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

sections.title: The fall of Gog.

verses.text: "And thou, son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal;"
"I will gather thee, and I will bring thee forth, and I will lead thee from the north parts, and will bring thee upon the mountains of Israel."
"And I will smite thy bow out of thy left hand, and will cause thine arrows to fall out of thy right hand; and I will leave thee upon the mountains of Israel."
"Thou and all thy bands, and the people that is with thee, shall fall upon the open field; I will give thee unto the ravenous birds of every sort, and to the beasts of the field to be devoured."
"Thou shalt fall upon the open field; for I have spoken it, saith the Lord God."
"And I will send a fire on Magog, and among them that dwell carelessly in the isles; and they shall know that I am the Lord."
"And my holy name shall be known in the midst of my people Israel; and I will not let them pollute my holy name any more; and the heathen shall know that I am the Lord, the Holy One in Israel."
"Behold, it is come, and it is done, saith the Lord God; this is the day whereof I have spoken."

"And they that dwell in the cities of Israel shall go forth, and shall set on fire and burn the weapons, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the handstaves and the spears, and they shall burn them with fire seven years."

"They shall take no wood out of the field, neither cut down any out of the forests; but they shall burn the weapons with fire; and they shall spoil those that spoiled them, and rob those that robbed them, saith the Lord God."

sections.title: The grave of Gog

verses.text: "And in that day, I will give to Gog a place of burial in Israel, by the sea of the east; it shall be called the valley of the travelers. And they shall bury Gog and all his multitude there; and they shall call it the valley of Gog's burial."
"The land shall be cleansed, and the people of Israel shall be buried for seven months."
"And all the inhabitants of the land shall be buried; and on the day when I am glorified, it shall be said to them, 'Thus says the Lord God.'"
"To cleanse the land, they shall bury those who remain upon the land, and the people who dwell upon the land shall be consumed; and after seven months, they shall search for the bones."
"And those who dwell upon the land shall not pass over; and if they see a man's bones, the buriers shall continue until they have buried them in the valley of Gog."
"Moreover, the name of the city shall be called the place of burial. Thus shall they cleanse the land."

"And you, son of man! Thus says the Lord God: 'To all the birds of the air and to every beast of the field, say: Come, gather yourselves and eat flesh, and drink blood, and be filled upon the mountains of Israel with the sacrifice, which is a great sacrifice, from all the fatness thereof.'"
"You shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of the rams, of the lambs, of the goats, and of the bullocks, all of them fatlings of Bashan."
"And I will give you the sacrifice until you are satisfied; you shall eat the fat until you are full, and you shall drink the blood until you are drunk."
"From among the horses and horsemen, from the mighty and the slain, you shall eat flesh, says the Lord God."

sections.title: The gathering of Israel once again.

verses.text: "And I shall give you my glory; and all the nations shall see my judgment, and they shall behold my hand upon them."
"From this day forth, they shall know that I am the Lord their God, who has been their God forever."

"And the nations shall know that the house of Israel has been made desolate because of their iniquities; and because I have turned my face away from them, I have delivered them into the hand of their enemies, and they have all fallen by the sword."
"As I have measured their iniquities and as I have dealt with their transgressions, so have I turned my face away from them."
"Therefore, thus says the Lord God: 'Now I will return the captivity of Jacob; and I will have mercy upon all the house of Israel; for my holy name's sake, I will be gracious.'"
"In their land they shall be scattered, and in their dwelling places they shall bear their shame and all their abominations; and there shall be none to frighten them."
"When I have returned them from among the nations, and gathered them from the lands of their enemies, in the sight of many nations, I shall be sanctified in them."

"And I will bring them to their own land, and I will gather them to their own place; and they shall know that I am the Lord their God, as I have been their God; and from that time forth, no man shall be left among them."
"And my face shall no longer be turned away from them; for I will pour out my Spirit upon the house of Israel," says the Lord God.

sections.title: Concerning the vision revealed regarding the new temple.

verses.text: In the twenty-fifth year of our captivity, in the first month, on the tenth day of the month, after the city was struck, in the fourteenth year, the hand of the Lord was upon me; and He brought me there.
The Lord brought me to the land of Israel in a vision; and He set me upon a very high mountain, and upon it was as it were the frame of a city on the south.
And He brought me there; and behold, there was a man whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze, with a line of flax in his hand and a measuring reed; and he stood by the gate.

And the man said unto me, “Son of man, behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears, and set thy heart upon all that I shall show thee; for to the intent that I might show them unto thee art thou brought hither: declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel.”

And behold, there was a wall round about the house; and in the man's hand was a measuring reed of six cubits long, each cubit being a cubit and a hand breadth; so he measured the breadth of the wall, one reed; and the height, one reed.
And he went toward the east gate, and went up its steps; and he measured the threshold of the gate, one reed; and the other threshold of the gate, one reed.

The length of the house was one reed; and the width was one reed; and between the houses there were five cubits; and the threshold of the gate was one reed; and on the inside, toward the west, was a measuring reed.
And he measured the threshold of the gate that was within, one reed.
The threshold of the gate was eight cubits; and the pillar of the gate was two cubits; and the threshold of the gate was within.
And the eastern houses were three on this side, and three on that side; and they were of one measure; and the pillar of the gate was one measure on this side and on that side.
And for the entrance of the gate, there were ten cubits in length, and for the width of the gate, there were thirty cubits made for it.

In front of the house of the holy place, on this side was one cubit, and on that side was one cubit; thus there was a threshold. And the house of the holy place had six cubits on this side and six cubits on that side.
From one door of the holy place to the other door, the width of the gate was twenty-five cubits; thus there was a gate on either side.
And the altar was twenty cubits in length; and around the altar was a wall of peace.
From the front of the gate, even to the inner gate of the holy place, there were fifty cubits.

And in the houses of the holy place, within the gate, there were windows of narrow lights; and also within the altar of peace, there were windows around; and upon every pillar of the gate, there was a cedar tree.
And he brought me to the inner court; and behold, there were houses built around the court; and there were thirty houses upon the wall.
And there were also houses beside the gates; and this was the lower house, according to the measure of the gates.
From the lower gate to the inner court, there was one hundred cubits in length, and toward the east and toward the north it was made.
And toward the north he led me; and behold, there was a gate in the outer court that looked toward the north; its length and width were made.

The chambers of the sanctuary were three on this side, and three on that side; the pillars of the house and the side chambers were of equal measure, and the windows were of fifty cubits in height, and the width was twenty-five cubits.
The doors, the side chambers, and the trees of the windows were as the door that looked toward the east; and there were seven steps that led up to it; and the side chambers were before it.
And in the inner court, on the north and on the east side, there was a door; and from door to door was one hundred cubits in length.
And toward the south was a gate; behold, there was a gate that looked toward the south; and the pillars of the house and the side chambers were of the same measure.
And around him and the side chambers were doors that resembled those; their length was fifty cubits, and the width was twenty-five cubits.

And there were seven steps that led up to it; and the side chambers were before it; and upon the pillars of the house, one was on this side and one was on that side, and the tree of the window was set upon them.
And in the inner court, on the south side, there was a door; and from door to door was one hundred cubits in length on the south side.
And the south gate led into the inner court; and likewise, he measured the south gate.
Likewise, he measured the chambers of the sanctuary and the pillars of the house; and around him and the side chambers were doors; their length was fifty cubits, and the width was twenty-five cubits.
And around it were rows of pillars; their length was twenty-five cubits, and their width was five cubits.
The chambers also looked toward the outer gate; and upon the threshold was a cedar tree; and there were eight steps leading up to it.
And in the inner gate, toward the east, there was a measure; and the length was as those.

Likewise, the measure of the storehouses and the threshold, and the chambers were for him; and around him and the chambers were windows; and the length was fifty cubits, and the width was twenty-five cubits.
The chambers looked toward the outer gate of the temple; and upon the threshold was a cedar tree on this side and on that side; and there were eight steps leading up to it.
And to the north, I brought in the gate; and likewise, the measure was for him;
The storehouses and the threshold, and the chambers were for him; and around it were windows; and the length was fifty cubits, and the width was twenty-five cubits.
The threshold looked toward the outer gate; and upon the threshold was a cedar tree on this side and on that side; and there were eight steps leading up to it.
And by the doors, beside the threshold, were the storehouse and the entrance; and there was the place for the sacrifices.
And the place for the sacrifices, the sin offerings and the trespass offerings were removed; and by the entrance of the gate, on this side were two tables, and on that side were two tables.
On the north side, by the outer gate, at the entrance, beside the steps, were two tables on one side; and on the other side, by the entrance of the gate, were two tables.
በበሩ አጠገብ በዚህ ወገን አራት ገበታዎች፥ በዚያም ወገን አራት ገበታዎች ነበሩ፤ መሥዋዕት የሚያርዱባቸው ገበታዎች ስምንት ነበሩ።
ስለሚቃጠለውም መሥዋዕት ርዝመታቸው አንድ ክንድ ተኩል ወርዳቸውም አንድ ክንድ ተኩል ቁመታቸውም አንድ ክንድ የሆኑ፥ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና ሌላውን መሥዋዕት የሚያርዱበትን ዕቃ ያኖሩባቸው ዘንድ፥ ከተጠረበ ድንጋይ የተሠሩ አራት ገበታዎች ነበሩ።
በዙሪያውም በስተውስጥ የነበረው የለዘበ ከንፈራቸው አንድ ጋት ነበረ፤ በገበታውም ላይ መክደኛ ነበረ፤ ከፀሐይና ከዝናምም የተሰወረ ነበረ።
ወደ ውስጠኛውም አደባባይ አገባኝ፤ እነሆም ሁለት ቤቶች ነበሩ፤ አንዱ ወደ ሰሜን በሚመለከተው በር አጠገብ ነበረ፤ መግቢያውም ወደ ደቡብ ይመለከት ነበረ፤ ሌላውም ወደ ደቡብ በሚመለከተው በር አጠገብ ነበረ፤ መግቢያውም ወደ ሰሜን ይመለከት ነበር።
ሰውዬውም፥ “ይህ ወደ ደቡብ የሚመለከት ቤት ለማገልገል ለሚተጉ ካህናት ነው።
ወደ ሰሜንም የሚመለከተው ቤት መሠዊያዉን ለማገልገል ለሚተጉ ካህናት ነው፤ እነዚህ ከሌዊ ልጆች መካከል ያገለግሉት ዘንድ ወደ እግዚአብሔር የሚቀርቡ የሳዶቅ ልጆች ናቸው” አለኝ።
አደባባዩንም በአራት ማዕዘኑ ርዝመቱን መቶ ክንድ፥ ወርዱንም መቶ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ፤ መሠዊያውም በቤቱ ፊት ነበረ።
ወደ ቤቱም ደጀ ሰላም አመጣኝ፤ የደጀ ሰላሙንም የግንብ አዕማድ ወርድ በዚህ ወገን አምስት ክንድ፤ በዚያም ወገን አምስት ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ፤ የበሩም ወርድ ዐሥራ አራት ክንድ ነበረ፤ በበሩም በዚህ ወገንና በዚያ ወገን የነበሩት ግንቦች ሦስት ሦስት ክንድ ነበሩ።
የደጀ ሰላሙም ርዝመት ሃያ ክንድ፥ ወርዱም ዐሥራ ሁለት ክንድ ነበረ፥ ወደ እርሱም የሚያደርሱ ዐሥር ደረጃዎች ነበሩ፤ አንድ በዚህ ወገን፥ አንድም በዚያ ወገን ሆነው በመቃኖቹ አጠገብ የግንብ አዕማድ ነበሩ።
And he brought me into the temple; and he made the pillars of the house six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.
And the entrance was ten cubits wide; and the entrance had five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side; and the length was forty cubits, and the breadth was twenty cubits.

And he entered within; and he measured the pillar of the entrance, which was two cubits; and the entrance was six cubits wide; and the pillar of the entrance was seven cubits on this side, and seven cubits on that side.
Before the temple, the length was forty cubits, and the breadth was twenty cubits; and he said unto me, "This is the holy of holies."
And the pillar of the temple was six cubits; and all around the temple were four cubits of the walls.
The walls were three cubits high, one above another; and in each story were thirty chambers. And around the temple, there were galleries to be joined with the pillars of the temple.

And around the house, there were pillars; and the chambers that were within were higher than the lower chambers, and the middle chambers; and there was a staircase leading from the lower to the middle, and from the middle to the upper.
And I saw that there was a raised platform around the temple; and the foundation of the pillars was full, being six cubits high.
And the outer wall of the pillars was five cubits thick; and there was a vacant space left beside the pillars of the temple.
And in the chambers of the treasures, the breadth was twenty cubits all around the house.

The entrance of the chambers was but one, and it was situated in the place where it was to dwell; one door faced the north way; and another door faced the south way; the place that was to dwell was five cubits all around.
In the west, there was a separate chamber whose width was seven cubits. And around the chamber there was a wall of five cubits, and its length was ten cubits.
The length of the house of the sanctuary was a hundred cubits, and the separate place and the chamber were made one hundred cubits in length with the wall.
Likewise, in the east, the length of the house of the sanctuary and the separate place was made one hundred cubits in length.

And at the back, in the outer part, there was a separate place whose length was made one hundred cubits with the walls that were there; and the inner sanctuary, and the chambers of the priests were made for you.
The corridors, the windows, and the arches were covered with wood on the inside; and around them were three rows of windows. The sanctuary was covered with wood from the ground up to the windows.
Upon the door, even to the inner part, and on the outside, the walls were all around covered.
The cherubim and the branches of the palm trees were carved; and the palm tree was between the cherub and the cherub; and each cherub had two faces.
On one side, toward the altar, the face of a man was seen; and on the other side, toward the altar, the face of a lion was seen; thus was it carved all around the house.
From the ground up to the top of the door, the cherubim and the branches of the palm trees were carved; such was the structure of the sanctuary.
And there were four pillars of the temple; and the appearance of the temple was like that of another appearance.

The altar was three cubits high, two cubits long, and two cubits wide, made of wood; and the pillars, the feet, and the bases were made of wood; and He said, “This is the table that is before the Lord.”
And there were two doors for the temple and for the holy place.
For each door, there were two folding leaves; for one door, two, and for the other door, two leaves were there.
And upon the top of the pillars, in the manner of these temple doors, were cherubim and palm trees; and on the outside, before the great sea, was a wooden platform.
And before the great sea, on both sides, were windows with latticework and palm trees; and the walls of the temple and the wooden platform were likewise.
In the outer court, I was brought forth by the way of the north, towards the east; and there were five houses of the sanctuary, situated in a special place, facing the north.
A hundred cubits was the length of the gate that was towards the north; and the width was fifty cubits.
In the inner court, there was a gate of twenty cubits in length; and in the outer court, there was a gate of twenty cubits, made with three doorposts, constructed in a manner that was fitting.
Before the houses of the sanctuary, there was a wall of ten cubits; the length was a hundred cubits; and their entrances faced towards the north.
The passageway was narrow, and the houses of the sanctuary were smaller than those in the middle and those below.
There were three doorposts constructed, and in the outer court, as they were, there were no pillars; therefore, they were narrower than those in the middle and those below.
Outside, adjacent to the houses of the sanctuary, there was a door that led to the outer court; the length of the houses of the sanctuary was fifty cubits.
The houses that were before the temple had a length of a hundred cubits; and those that were in the outer court had a length of fifty cubits.
Below these houses, towards the southeast, there was an entrance through which a man would enter from the outer court; this was located beside the door.
In the south, in a special place, there were houses of the sanctuary.

And the way that was on their side was as it had been in the north, as the way of the houses of the sacred things. Their length, and their width, and their exits, and their ordinances, and their chambers were all in accordance with that.
And in the south, there was a gate of entrance beside the wall, towards the east, at the head of the gate.

Thus said I, “In a special place, concerning the houses of the sacred things that are in the north and in the south, they are the houses that the sons of Zadok, the priests, shall offer to the Lord, for they are more holy than all others that eat the holy things. For the place is holy, and therein they shall bear the holy things, the offerings of the grain, and the sacrifices for sin and for transgression.”

And when the priests enter, they shall not go out of the sanctuary; but their garments in which they minister are holy, and they shall remain in them; but they shall put on other garments to go out to the people.”
And the inner house, when it is finished, shall lead me to the east, towards the gate; and he shall surround it.
And I stood behind the gate that faces the east; and I measured the width of the east side, five hundred cubits, and it was for the house.
And I went towards the north; and I measured the width of the north side, five hundred cubits, and it was for the house.
And I went towards the south; and I measured the width of the south side, five hundred cubits, and it was for the house.
And I went towards the west; and I measured the width of the west side, five hundred cubits, and it was for the house.
And for the four sides, it was for the house; the length of the holy and the unholy was to be five hundred cubits, and the width was five hundred cubits, which was the wall all around.

sections.title: The glory of the Lord is a radiant light.

verses.text: ወደ ምሥራቅም ወደሚመለከተው በር አመጣኝ።
እነሆም የእስራኤል አምላክ ክብር ከምሥራቅ መንገድ መጣ፤ ድምፁም እንደ ብዙ ውኆች ይተምም ነበር፤ ከክብሩም የተነሣ ምድር ታበራ ነበር።
ያየሁትም ራእይ ከተማዪቱን ለማጥፋት በመጣሁ ጊዜ እንደ አየሁት ራእይ ነበረ፤ ራእዩም በኮቦር ወንዝ እንደአየሁት ራእይ ነበረ፤ እኔም በግምባሬ ተደፋሁ።
የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ወደ ምሥራቅ በሚመለከት በር ወደ መቅደሱ ገባ።
መንፈስም አነሣኝ፤ ወደ ውስጠኛውም አደባባይ አገባኝ፤ እነሆም የእግዚአብሔር ክብር መቅደሱን መልቶት ነበር።
በመቅደሱም ሆኖ የሚናገረኝን ሰማሁ፤ በአጠገቤም ሰው ቆሞ ነበር።
እንዲህም አለኝ፥ “የሰው ልጅ ሆይ! በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ለዘለዓለም የምቀመጥበት የዙፋኔ ስፍራና የእግሬ ጫማ መረገጫ ይህ ነው። ዳግመኛም የእስራኤል ቤትና ነገሥታቶቻቸው በዝሙታቸውና በከፍታዎቻቸው በአለው በነገሥታቶቻቸው ሬሳ ቅዱስ ስሜን አያረክሱም።
መድረካቸውን በመድረኬ አጠገብ፥ መቃናቸውንም በመቃኔ አጠገብ አድርገዋልና። በእኔና በእነርሱ መካከል ግንብ ብቻ ነበረ፤ በሠሩትም ርኵሰት ቅዱስ ስሜን አረከሱ፤ ስለዚህ በቍጣዬ አጠፋኋቸው።
አሁንም ዝሙታቸውንና የነገሥታቶቻቸውን ሬሳ ከእኔ ዘንድ ያርቁ፤ እኔም ለዘለዓለም በመካከላቸው አድራለሁ።
“አንተም የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ሥራቸውንና ኀጢአታቸውን ይተዉ ዘንድ ለእስራኤል ቤት ይህን ቤት አሳያቸው፤ አምሳያውንም ይለኩ።

And they shall receive their recompense for all the work they have done; and thou shalt make known unto them the form of the house and the pattern thereof, and the goings out thereof, and the comings in thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and all the laws thereof; and thou shalt write it before their eyes, that they may keep all the ordinances and all the laws thereof, and do them.
Upon the summit of the mountain, the house that is there, and the ordinances of the house, shall be holy; and all the borders round about shall be holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.

sections.title: The arrangement of the offerings.

verses.text: The dimensions of the altar are thus: its height is one cubit, and its width is one cubit; it is square, and its height is likewise one cubit. The altar shall have a horn on each of its four corners, and the height of the altar shall be as such.

Upon the earth, from the foundation that is laid, even unto the lowest step, there are two cubits, and its width is one cubit; from the smallest step to the largest step, there are four cubits, and its width is one cubit.
The measurement of the platform is four cubits; and upon the platform, there is one cubit, and there are four corners that rise upwards.
The length of the platform is twelve cubits, and its width is twelve cubits; and the four corners are perfectly aligned.

The length of the base is fourteen cubits, and its width is fourteen cubits; and the four corners are perfectly aligned; and all around it is a ledge of one cubit; and the foundation is one cubit all around; and the steps shall face towards the east.

Thus spoke I: "O son of man! The Lord God saith thus: Concerning the offering that is to be brought, let it be done in accordance with the law of the altar, and on the day that they shall offer, let their blood be sprinkled; this is the law of the altar."

"And concerning the offerings that are to be presented to me, let it be from the seed of Sadok, from the priests who are of the Levites, and for the sin offerings that shall be made, you shall give one bullock or a ram; thus saith the Lord God."

"From the blood, you shall take; upon the four corners of the altar, upon the four sides of the base, and all around upon the ledge, you shall sprinkle; thus shall you be cleansed; thus shall you be sanctified."
"For the sin offerings, you shall take a ram; and outside the sanctuary, in the designated place, it shall be offered."
"On the second day, for the sin offerings, you shall offer a bullock without blemish; and as the ram is to be cleansed, so shall the altar be cleansed."
And after you have performed the purification, you shall offer a lamb without blemish, and a goat without blemish shall be offered to the Lord;
Before the Lord, you shall present them; and the priests shall add salt to them; and they shall prepare the offerings that are to be made for the Lord.
For seven days, you shall offer a young bull as a sin offering each day; and one lamb without blemish and one goat without blemish shall be offered each day.
For seven days, they shall prepare for the sanctuary; they shall be cleansed; they shall be consecrated.
And when the days are completed, on the eighth day, thereafter the priests shall offer your sin offerings, and your peace offerings upon the altar; and I will accept you, says the Lord God.

sections.title: The Eastern Gate that is prepared.

verses.text: And to the east, toward the place that is outside, to the altar, I returned; and it was closed.
And the Lord said to me, “This gate shall be shut; it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter by it; for the Lord God of Israel has entered by it, therefore it shall be shut.”
But the prince, he shall eat bread before the Lord; he shall go in by way of the porch of that gate, and shall go out by the same way.”
And the way of the north gate brought me before the house; and behold, the glory of the Lord filled the house of the Lord; and I fell upon my face.
