And the Lord said to me, “Son of man, set your heart upon, and observe with your eyes, and hear with your ears all that I say to you concerning all the ordinances of the house of the Lord, and all the laws thereof; and set your heart upon the entering in of the house, with all the going forth of the sanctuary.”
To the rebellious house, to the house of Israel, thus says the Lord God: “O house of Israel, let your abominations be removed from me.”

When you offer my bread, and my fat, and my blood, in the time of your offering, that they may be in my sanctuary, and that my house may be sanctified; for you have brought in strangers, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to pollute my house; and you have offered my bread, and my fat, and my blood, and you have broken my covenant because of all your abominations.
You have not kept my ordinances; but let others keep the ordinances of my sanctuary for yourselves.”
Thus says the Lord God: “No stranger, uncircumcised in heart, nor uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any of the children of Israel.”
And they shall bear the iniquity of their transgressions, for they have followed their idols, and they shall bear their iniquities without fail.

Yet, within My sanctuary, they shall be ministers; and within My house, they shall be doorkeepers; and within My house, they shall serve; and for the people, they shall offer the sacrifices of atonement and other offerings; and they shall stand before them to minister.

For they were serving before their idols, and for the house of Israel, they have become a cause of sin; therefore, I have lifted My hand against them, says the Lord God; they shall bear their iniquities.
And they shall not draw near to Me to serve in the priesthood, nor come near to the holy things, nor to the most holy; but they shall bear their shame and the abominations which they have committed.
Yet for all their service and for all that is done in them, I shall appoint guardians of the ordinances of My house.

"Yet the children of Israel, who have kept the charge of My sanctuary, the sons of Zadok, who minister to Me, shall come near to Me to minister; they shall stand before Me to offer the fat and the blood, says the Lord God."
And they shall enter into My sanctuary; they shall minister to Me, and they shall bring their offerings to My table; and they shall keep My ordinances.
And when they enter the inner gate, they shall wear linen garments; and in the inner court, when they minister, they shall not wear anything that causes sweat.
Upon themselves, they shall wear linen turbans; and upon their loins, they shall wear linen trousers; they shall not gird themselves with anything that causes sweat.

And when they go out to the outer court to the people, they shall take off their garments in which they have ministered, and lay them in the holy chambers; and they shall put on other garments, so that they do not sanctify the people by their garments.
They shall not shave their heads, nor let their locks grow long; they shall keep their hair well trimmed.
And the priests shall not drink wine or strong drink when they go into the inner court.
They shall not take a wife who is a harlot or a divorced woman; but they shall take as wives a virgin of the seed of the house of Israel, or a widow of a priest.
Between the holy and the profane, let them teach My people the difference; and between the unclean and the clean, let them show them.
When there is a dispute, let them stand to judge; as judges they shall judge; and in all My appointed feasts, they shall keep My laws and My statutes; and they shall hallow My Sabbaths.
They shall not defile themselves for a dead person; except for a father, or for a mother, or for a son, or for a daughter, or for a brother, or for a sister who has not had a husband.
After a period of seven days, they shall be cleansed.
And when they go in to minister in the holy place, they shall bring their sin offering, says the Lord God.
"They shall not have an inheritance; I am their inheritance; and you shall give them no possession in Israel; I am their possession."
They shall eat the offerings of the grain and the sin offerings, and the offerings of the trespass; and everything that is consecrated in Israel shall be theirs.

The first of all the firstfruits of every kind, and every sacrifice of your sacrifices shall be for the priests; and in your houses, you shall give the first of your dough to the priests, that he may cause a blessing to rest on your house.
Do not let the priests who have been torn by wild beasts or those who have been broken by the dogs be called.

sections.title: The division of the inheritance of the earth.

verses.text: "And you shall make a portion of the holy offering from the land, which you shall offer to the Lord, when you divide the land by lot. Its length shall be twenty-five thousand cubits, and its width shall be twenty thousand cubits; all around its border shall be holy."
"And from him, the length shall be five hundred, and the width shall be five hundred cubits, a square place for the sanctuary; and around it shall be a vacant space of fifty cubits."
"Then likewise, the length shall be twenty-five thousand cubits, and the width shall be ten thousand cubits; this shall be your holy place within it, a sanctuary for the holy ones."

"And it shall be a portion of the holy offering from the land; it shall be for the priests who minister to the Lord, for the Levites who serve in the sanctuary, and for their houses; it shall be a holy place for the sanctuary."

"Its length shall be twenty-five thousand cubits, and its width shall be ten thousand cubits; this shall be a place for the servants of the house, a dwelling for the Levites, and it shall be an inheritance with twenty houses."

"And for the city, you shall make a place adjacent to the holy portion, and its width shall be five thousand, and its length shall be twenty-five thousand cubits; this shall be for all the house of Israel."

"And for the prince, there shall be a portion adjacent to the holy offering and the city; it shall extend on this side and that side, before the holy offering and the city, toward the west and toward the east; its length shall be as one of the portions of the holy offering, from the border of the land on the west to the border on the east."
"This shall be the portion for Israel; the leaders of the people shall give the land to the house of Israel according to their measure, but the people shall no longer be distressed from now on."

"Thus says the Lord God: 'O leaders of Israel! You should judge with righteousness; put away violence and oppression; do justice and righteousness; cease from your exactions upon my people,' says the Lord God."
"You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin."

Likewise, let the measure of the empty be one; the measure of the empty, the tenth part of the measure of Korah, and the measure of If shall be the tenth part of the measure of Korah. Let the measure be as the measure of Korah.
Let there be twenty measures of barley; twenty measures, five measures of barley, and ten measures of barley; may it be so unto you.
"The offering which you shall present is this: from one measure of Korah, one sixth part of the measure of If; and from one measure of Korah, one sixth part of the measure of If shall you give."
As for the oil, you shall give the tenth part of the measure of the empty from each measure of Korah; for ten measures of the empty is one measure of Korah.

From Israel's assembly, from the flock of two hundred, you shall give one ram; this shall atone for your sins, that it may be for the grain offering and for the sin offering, and for the offering of safety,” saith the Lord God.
And all the people of the land shall give this measure to the leader of Israel.

At each of your feasts, at each of your appointed times, and at each of your Sabbaths, for the house of Israel, every year at the feast, the offerings that are to be made and the grain offerings of the grain shall be given upon the leader; he shall offer for the house of Israel to atone for the sin offerings and the grain offerings, the offerings that are to be made and the offerings of safety.
Thus saith the Lord God, “In the first month, on the first day of the month, take the heifer without blemish from the flock; and cleanse the sanctuary.”
And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering and sprinkle it upon the posts of the sanctuary and upon the four corners of the altar, and within the inner court.
And on the seventh day of the month, do likewise; for this is concerning the sin and concerning all that is defiled. Likewise, concerning the house, you shall make atonement.
"In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, ye shall keep the feast of Passover. And until the seventh day, ye shall eat unleavened bread."
"And on that day, the leader shall offer a sin offering for himself and for all the people of his nation."

"And during the feast, on the seven days, ye shall offer a sin offering unto the Lord; on each of the seven days, ye shall offer a goat without blemish, and for sin offerings, on each day, one young bullock shall be offered."

"For one goat, one of the prescribed measure; for one bullock, one of the prescribed measure; for one goat, one of the prescribed measure, and one of the prescribed measure of oil for the grain offering shall be offered."

"In the seventh month, on the fifteenth day of the month, during the feast of seven days, ye shall offer the sin offerings for the transgressions, and the offerings that shall be made for the grain offering shall likewise be offered with oil."

sections.title: The gathering of Israel and the observance of the feasts.

verses.text: The Lord God saith, “The gate that looketh toward the east, which is within the inner court, shall be shut on the sixth day; but on the Sabbath day it shall be opened, and on the day of the new moon it shall be opened.”

The prince shall stand by the gate's entrance, and he shall come in by the way of the porch of the gate, and he shall stand by the post of the gate; and the priests shall prepare his burnt offerings and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate; and afterward he shall go forth; but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.
And the people of the land shall worship at the entrance of that gate before the Lord on the Sabbaths and on the new moons.
And the prince shall offer unto the Lord on the Sabbath day six lambs without blemish, and one without blemish shall be a ram;

And for the grain offering, let there be one ephah for a ram, and for the lambs, as he is able to give, let there be a grain offering, and for one lamb, let there be one ephah of fine flour mixed with oil.
And on the day of the new moon, let there be one lamb without blemish, and six lambs without blemish, and one without blemish ram shall be offered;

For the lamb, let there be one ephah of fine flour, and for the ram, let there be one ephah of fine flour, and for the lambs, as he is able to give, let there be a grain offering, and for one lamb, let there be one ephah of fine flour mixed with oil for the grain offering.
And the prince shall enter in at the proper time by the way of the gate that faceth toward the east; and he shall go forth by the same way.

“But the people of the land, when they come before the Lord at the appointed feasts, shall go out by the way of the south gate, and they shall go forth by the north gate; and the north gate shall go forth by the south gate; they shall not return by the gate whereby they came in, but shall go forth over against it.”
When the people enter in, the prince shall be in the midst of them; and when they go forth, he shall go forth.

On the days of feasts and solemn festivals, the offering of flour shall be one ephah for the bullock, one ephah for the ram, and as much as one is able for the goats, and one ephah of fine flour shall be the measure for the oil.

And the overseer shall offer the sacrifice according to his command, whether it be the sacrifice of the burnt offering or the sacrifice of the peace offering which he shall offer unto the Lord; and at the time of offering, the gate that looks toward the east shall be opened; and on the Sabbath day, as it is done, he shall offer the sacrifice of the burnt offering and the sacrifice of the peace offering; and after this, he shall go out; and when he goes out, the gate shall be shut.
“Every day, for the burnt offering that is to be offered, you shall offer one lamb of the first year without blemish unto the Lord; you shall offer it every morning.

And with him shall be the flour offering, mixed with oil, as the measure of the oil for the flour offering, and the sixth part of an ephah of fine flour; you shall offer it every morning; this is an everlasting ordinance.
Likewise, for the daily burnt offering, the lamb and the flour offering shall be offered every morning.
The Lord God says, “If the overseer gives a portion of the inheritance to one of his sons, let it be for his sons; it shall be an inheritance for them.

However, if he gives a portion of the inheritance to one of his servants, it shall be until the year of jubilee; thereafter, it shall return to the overseer; but the inheritance shall remain for his sons.
The overseer shall not take away from the people their inheritance; let the inheritance remain for the children, that my people may not be scattered from their inheritance.
And at the gate, by the entrance that looks toward the north, for the priests, which is for the holy place, let it be brought; behold, there was a place behind it toward the sea.

And he said unto me, “This is the place where the priests shall sanctify the people, that they may not go out to the outer court, to offer the burnt offerings and the sin offerings, and where they shall sprinkle the flour offering.”
He brought me forth to the outer court; and there was a way leading to the four corners, and behold, in the outer court, there was a way in every corner.
In the outer court, the length of each of the four corners was forty cubits, and the width was thirty cubits; thus, it was a square, and in the corners were equal spaces for these four places.
And all around the four corners was a wall, and beneath the wall was a place for the drainage.
And He said unto me, “These are the places where the servants of the house shall prepare the offerings of the people.”

sections.title: The source that seeketh beneath the temple.

verses.text: And I returned to the temple, and behold, water was issuing from under the threshold of the house toward the east; for the front of the house faced east. The water flowed down from under the right side of the house, at the south of the altar.
And he brought me out by the north gate, and led me around on the outside to the outer gate that faces east; and behold, water was trickling out on the right side.
And the man went forth with a measuring line in his hand, and measured a thousand cubits; and he caused me to pass through the water, and the water was to my ankles.

Again he measured a thousand, and caused me to pass through the water, and the water was to my knees. Again he measured a thousand, and caused me to pass through the water, and the water was to my loins.
Again he measured a thousand; but the river could not be passed over, for the water was deep, enough to swim in, a river that could not be passed over.
And he said unto me, “Son of man, hast thou seen this?” And he brought me, and caused me to return to the bank of the river.
And when I returned, behold, at the bank of the river were very many trees on one side and on the other.
Then he said unto me, “This water flows toward the eastern region and goes down into the Arabah; and when it enters the sea, the waters will be healed.

And it shall come to pass that every living thing that moves, wherever the river goes, shall live; and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters go there; for they shall be healed, and everything shall live wherever the river goes.

And it shall come to pass that fishers shall stand by it from En-gedi even unto En-eglaim; they shall be a place to spread nets; their fish shall be according to their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceeding many.
The wilderness and the dry land shall rejoice, but the salt shall not be removed.

And by the river, on the bank thereof, every tree that bringeth forth fruit shall flourish; its leaf also shall not wither; and its fruit shall not be consumed; for the water shall flow out from the sanctuary, and every month it shall bear fruit; and the fruit shall be for food, and the leaf shall be for healing.

sections.title: The boundaries of the land.

verses.text: The Lord God saith, "This shall be the boundary whereby ye shall divide the land for the twelve tribes of Israel. For Joseph there shall be two portions."
"For I had lifted up mine hand to give unto your fathers, and ye shall equally divide it among yourselves; and this land shall be your inheritance."
"And this is the boundary of the land. From the great sea on the north side, beginning at the way of Hethlon unto the entrance of Zedad;"
"Hamath, Berothah, and the border of Damascus, and the border of Hamath, shall be the border thereof, and the border of Haran shall be adjacent thereto."
"The border shall be from the sea to the border of Damascus, and on the north side shall be the border of Hamath. This is the northern border."

"And the southern border shall be from the border of Hauran, and from Damascus, and from Gilead, in the midst of the land of Israel. From the northern border shall it extend to the southern sea, even unto Tamar, this is the southern border."
"And the western border shall be from Tamar unto the waters of Meribah, even unto the river of Egypt, and unto the great sea shall it extend. This is the western border."
"And the eastern border shall be from the southern border, even unto Hamath's entrance, unto the great sea shall it extend. This is the eastern border."
"This land shall ye divide among yourselves, the twelve tribes of Israel."

"And for you, and for those who dwell among you, and for your children who shall be born among you, ye shall make an inheritance by lot; and they shall be as the native-born among the children of Israel; they shall inherit with you among the tribes of Israel."
And the scribe shall say, "In whatever manner he may stand among you, therein shall you give him his inheritance," saith the Lord God.

sections.title: The division of the land.

verses.text: "The name of the cities is this: It shall begin at the entrance of Hamath, by the border of Damascus, and shall extend northward. Their border shall be from the east to the west. For Dan, it shall be one portion of land."
"And the border of Dan shall extend northward from the east to the west, and for Asher, it shall be one portion of land."
"And the border of Asher shall extend northward from the east to the west, and for Naphtali, it shall be one portion of land."
"And the border of Naphtali shall extend northward from the east to the west, and for Manasseh, it shall be one portion of land."
"And the border of Manasseh shall extend northward from the east to the west, and for Ephraim, it shall be one portion of land."
"And the border of Ephraim shall extend northward from the east to the west, and for Reuben, it shall be one portion of land."
"And the border of Reuben shall extend northward from the east to the west, and for Judah, it shall be one portion of land."

"And the border of Judah shall extend northward from the east to the west, and for Mecca, it shall be a separate portion; and its length shall be twenty-five thousand cubits; its breadth from the east to the west shall be as one of the portions; and the temple shall be in the midst of them."
"For the Lord, the portion you shall measure for Mecca shall be twenty-five thousand cubits, and its breadth shall be ten thousand cubits."

"And the temple shall be for the priests; its length shall be twenty-five thousand cubits to the north, and to the west, its breadth shall be ten thousand cubits; to the east, its breadth shall be ten thousand cubits; and to the south, its length shall be twenty-five thousand cubits. And the house of the Lord shall be in the midst of them."
የእስራኤልም ልጆች በሳቱ ጊዜ፥ ሌዋውያን እንደ ሳቱ ላልሳቱት፥ ሥርዐቴን ለጠበቁት፥ ከሳዶቅ ልጆች ወገን ለተቀደሱት ካህናት ይሆናል።
ከምድርም መባ የተለየ ሌላ መባ ይሆንላቸዋል፤ ከተቀደሱትም ይልቅ የተቀደሰ ይሆናል፤ በሌዋውያን ድንበር አጠገብ ይሆናል።
በካህናቱም ድንበር አቅራቢያ ርዝመቱ ሃያ አምስት ሺህ፥ ወርዱም ዐሥር ሺህ የሆነ ዕጣ ለሌዋውያን ይሆናል፤ ርዝመቱ ሁሉ ሃያ አምስት ሺህ፥ ወርዱም ሃያ ሺህ ክንድ ይሆናል።
ለእግዚአብሔርም የተቀደሰ ነውና ከእርሱ ምንም አይሸጡም፤ አይለውጡምም፤ የምድሩም ቀዳምያት አይፋለስም።
በሃያ አምስቱ ሺህ አንጻር አምስት ሺህ ወርድ ያለው የቀረ ቅዱስ ያይደለ ስፍራ ለከተማዪቱ ለጋራ ጉዳይዋ፥ ለመኖሪያ፥ ለማሰማርያም ይሆናል፤ ከተማዪቱም በመካከሉ ትሆናለች።
ልክዋም ይህ ነው፤ በሰሜን በኩል አራት ሺህ አምስት መቶ፥ በደቡብም በኩል አራት ሺህ አምስት መቶ፥ በምሥራቅም በኩል አራት ሺህ አምስት መቶ፥ በምዕራብም በኩል አራት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ክንድ ይሆናል።
ለከተማዪቱም ማሰማርያ ይኖራታል፤ በሰሜን በኩል ሁለት መቶ አምሳ፥ በደቡብም በኩል ሁለት መቶ አምሳ፥ በምሥራቅም በኩል ሁለት መቶ አምሳ፥ በምዕራብም በኩል ሁለት መቶ አምሳ ክንድ ይሆናል።
“በተቀደሰው መባ አንጻር የተረፈው ርዝመቱ ወደ ምሥራቅ ዐሥር ሺህ፥ ወደ ምዕራብም ዐሥር ሺህ ክንድ ይሆናል። በተቀደሰው መባ አንጻር ይሆናል። ፍሬውም ከተማዪቱን ለሚያገለግሉ መብል ይሆናል።
ከእስራኤል ነገድ ሁሉ ከተማዪቱን የሚያገለግሉ ያርሱታል።
መባው ሁሉ ርዝመቱ ሃያ አምስት ሺህ፥ ወርዱም ሃያ አምስት ሺህ ክንድ ይሆናል፤ የተቀደሰውን መባ ከከተማዪቱ ይዞታ ጋር አራት ማዕዘን አድርጋችሁ ትሰጣላችሁ።

"And the holy portion shall be for the priest, in the midst of the city, and it shall be for the ruler, as it is written; from the boundary of the east to the boundary of the west, five and twenty thousand cubits, and from the north to the south, five and twenty thousand cubits, all around, it shall be for the ruler; and the holy portion shall be in the midst of it."

"The inheritance of the Levites, and the city’s portion shall be in the midst of that which is for the ruler; between the boundary of Judah and the boundary of Benjamin shall be the portion for the ruler."
"And for the residue of the things, thus shall it be; from the east to the west, for Benjamin shall be one portion."
"From the boundary of Benjamin, continuing from the east to the west, for Simeon shall be one portion."
"From the boundary of Simeon, continuing from the east to the west, for Issachar shall be one portion."
"From the boundary of Issachar, continuing from the east to the west, for Zebulun shall be one portion."
"From the boundary of Zebulun, continuing from the east to the west, for Gad shall be one portion."
"From the boundary of Gad, continuing to the south, from Tamar to the waters of Meribah, even to the great sea shall be the boundary."
"You shall assign an inheritance to the children of Israel; this is the land which you shall divide by lot for an inheritance, and each portion shall be as follows, thus saith the Lord God."

sections.title: The gates of the city of Jerusalem.

verses.text: "The gates of the city are these: on the north side, there shall be four thousand five hundred cubits."
"The gates of the city shall bear names like the gates of Israel; on the north side, there shall be one gate of Reuben, one gate of Judah, and one gate of Levi; thus shall there be three gates."
"On the east side, there shall be four thousand five hundred cubits, and there shall be three gates; one gate of Joseph, one gate of Benjamin, and one gate of Dan."
"On the south side, there shall be four thousand five hundred cubits, and there shall be three gates; one gate of Simeon, one gate of Issachar, and one gate of Zebulun."
"On the west side, there shall be four thousand five hundred cubits, and there shall be three gates; one gate of Gad, one gate of Asher, and one gate of Naphtali."
"The circumference shall be eighteen thousand cubits, and the name of the city from that day shall be called: 'The Lord is there.'"
